column2: Breithneachadh na sgoile-ealain, le Mr. Salty

column1: A test pattern, the video synth, and drawing on the picture, saved as a still.
column2: Dealbh deuchainn, an synth bhidio, agus tarraing air an dealbh, air a shàbhaladh mar dhealbh-stad.

column1: The telestrator booth, with Coach Marv
column2: Bothan an telestrator, le Coach Marv

column1: A heart from the library, the pen, invert and feather.
column2: Cridhe bhon leabharlann, am peann, tionndaidh agus maothaich.

column1: The Signal Files: redact the evidence
column2: Faidhlichean nan Comharran: falaich an fhianais

column1: A corner pin, two soft edges, then three slices in the Screens window.
column2: Prìne oisein, dà oir bhog, an uairsin trì sliseagan ann an uinneag Screens.

column1: The haunted lighthouse, with Keeper Rook
column2: An taigh-solais tathaichte, le Fear-gleidhidh Rook

column1: Cue numbers, GOTO, a hotkey, and where Companion, MIDI and OSC come in.
column2: Àireamhan cue, GOTO, iuchair-ghoirid, agus far an tig Companion, MIDI agus OSC a-steach.

column1: The game show, with Donna Wheel
A Lower Third with a name on it, then a title card with a key-green backdrop.
column2: Bann-ainm le ainm air, an uairsin cairt-tiotail le cùl-raon uaine iuchrach.

column1: The kaiju weather report, with June O'Neil
column2: Aimsir nan kaiju, le June O'Neil

column1: A stage timer counting down, held, and a presenter view for the person on stage.
column2: Uaireadair àrd-ùrlair a' cunntadh sìos, air a chumail, agus sealladh preasantair don neach air an àrd-ùrlar.

column1: A grand day out, with Wallis and Grommet
column2: Latha mòr a-muigh, le Wallis agus Grommet

column1: A second playlist as a layer, and TAKE ALL so two things change on one beat.
column2: Dara liosta mar shreath, agus TAKE ALL gus an atharraich dà rud air aon bhuille.

column1: The magic show, with Turnip Top
column2: An taisbeanadh draoidheachd, le Turnip Top

column1: BLACK against PANIC, and getting a show back.
column2: BLACK an aghaidh PANIC, agus taisbeanadh fhaighinn air ais.

column1: The cooking show, with Chef Bork
column2: An taisbeanadh còcaireachd, le Chef Bork

column1: Capture a look on a DASH button, change everything, and get it back with one press.
column2: Glac coltas air putan DASH, atharraich a h-uile càil, agus faigh air ais e le aon bhrùthadh.

column1: The styles beyond the crossfade: an iris, a shatter, and their times.
column2: Na stoidhlichean seachad air a' chrossfade: iris, bristeadh, agus na h-amannan aca.

column1: The space-opera trailer, with Optimus Primetime
An audio effect on a cue, a bend that damages it beautifully, and where the patch lives.
column2: Buaidh fuaim air cue, lùb a mhillis gu brèagha e, agus far a bheil am patch a' fuireach.

column1: The robot DJs, with Deft Funk
column2: Na DJs inneil, le Deft Funk

column1: The waveform, the vectorscope, and false colour: is the glow real, or just too bright?
column2: An cruth-tonn, an vectorscope, agus dath meallta: a bheil an deàrrsadh fìor, no dìreach ro shoilleir?

column1: The Signal Files: is the glow on the horizon a craft?
column2: Faidhlichean nan Comharran: an e soitheach a th' anns an deàrrsadh air fàire?

column1: Where NDI, SDI and ST 2110 live, and NDI switched on where this computer has it.
column2: Far a bheil NDI, SDI agus ST 2110 a' fuireach, agus NDI air far a bheil e aig a' choimpiutair seo.

column1: The webcam as a controller, as a game. Five rounds, a high score.
column2: An camara-lìn mar smachd, mar gheama. Còig cuairtean, sgòr as àirde.

column1: Windows, the ... menu, what each one shows, layouts, and tally.
column2: Uinneagan, an clàr ..., na tha gach tè a' sealltainn, cruthan, agus tally.

column1: Mystery on the starship Cathode, with Lt. Haila and Ensign Jinkley
column2: Dìomhaireachd air an long-fànais Cathode, le Lt. Haila agus Ensign Jinkley

column1: DR. PIXEL: Two playlists: Deckboy becomes SUPER DECKBOY. It earned it, skapi.
column2: DR. PIXEL: Dà liosta-chluich: bidh Deckboy na SUPER DECKBOY. Choisinn e e, skapi.

column1: PROF. VIDEO: It evolved! My oscillators never got a fanfare.
column2: PROF. VIDEO: Dh'atharraich e! Cha d' fhuair na h-oscillators agam fanfare a-riamh.

column1: DR. PIXEL: SUPER DECKBOY! Every show deserves one. Bravo.
column2: DR. PIXEL: SUPER DECKBOY! Tha fear airidh air gach taisbeanadh. Math fhèin.

column1: PROF. VIDEO: The power-up! More playlists, more layers, more super.
column2: PROF. VIDEO: An cumhachd! Barrachd liostaichean, barrachd sreathan, barrachd super.

column1: Intro video (left on the office PC)
column2: Bhidio fosglaidh (air fhàgail air coimpiutair na h-oifis)

column1: A show you built here, skapi, running on a laptop somewhere else tonight. Press START.
column2: Taisbeanadh a thog thu an seo, skapi, a' ruith a-nochd air laptop ann an àite eile. Brùth START.

column1: Before it travels: check it, fix it, bundle it.
column2: Mus fhalbh e: dearbh e, càraich e, pasgain e.

column1: See CHECK in the top bar? It only appears when something is wrong. Press it.
column2: Am faic thu CHECK sa bhàr gu h-àrd? Cha nochd e ach nuair a tha rudeigin ceàrr. Brùth e.

column1: It lists everything a show would trip over: missing files, empty cues, unreachable outputs.
column2: Bidh e a' liostadh a h-uile càil a thuislicheadh taisbeanadh: faidhlichean a dhìth, cues falamh, às-chuir nach ruigear.

column1: The intro video is on another computer. Select it and delete it, or RELINK it if you have the file.
column2: Tha a' bhidio fosglaidh air coimpiutair eile. Tagh i agus sguab às i, no dèan RELINK oirre ma tha am faidhle agad.

column1: Fix it at home, where it is easy. Not at the venue, where it is not.
column2: Càraich aig an taigh e, far a bheil e furasta. Chan ann aig an ionad, far nach eil.

column1: Press BUNDLE and choose where: a USB stick, a shared folder. The show and all its media, together.
column2: Brùth PASGAN COMHLA agus tagh càite: maide USB, pasgan co-roinnte. An taisbeanadh agus a h-uile meadhan aige, còmhla.

column1: The copy finds its media beside it, wherever the folder goes.
column2: Lorgaidh an lethbhreac na meadhanan aige ri thaobh, ge be càite an tèid am pasgan.

column1: Checked, fixed, bundled. On the other machine, open the bundle's show: everything is where it should be.
column2: Air a dhearbhadh, air a chàradh, air a phasgadh. Air an inneal eile, fosgail taisbeanadh a' phasgain: tha a h-uile càil far am bu chòir.

column1: A show file is only text, so it travels light. The media is the heavy part.
column2: Chan eil ann am faidhle taisbeanaidh ach teacsa, mar sin siubhlaidh e aotrom. 'S iad na meadhanan am pàirt trom.

column1: An art school, skapi. One student, one picture, one critic who has seen it all. Press START.
column2: Sgoil-ealain, skapi. Aon oileanach, aon dealbh, aon bhreitheamh a chunnaic a h-uile càil. Brùth START.

column1: Effects change a picture; an oscillator keeps changing it. The critic only likes the second kind.
column2: Atharraichidh buadhan dealbh; cumaidh oscillator ga atharrachadh. Cha toil leis a' bhreitheamh ach an dàrna seòrsa.

column1: A grey square on beige. I have seen this at every graduate show since 1987.
column2: Ceàrnag ghlas air beige. Chunna mi seo aig a h-uile taisbeanadh ceumnachaidh bho 1987.

column1: In the inspector's EFFECTS section, + adds one. Edges is a good start: it draws the outlines.
column2: Ann an earrann EFFECTS an inspector, cuiridh + tè ris. 'S e deagh thoiseach a th' ann an Edges: tarraingidh e na h-oirean.

column1: There are dozens. Every one runs on the CPU in a few milliseconds. Mostly.
column2: Tha dusanan ann. Ruithidh gach tè air a' CPU ann am beagan mhilidiogan. Mar as trice.

column1: Take a risk! Bad art is fine. Boring art is a crime.
column2: Gabh cothrom! Tha droch ealain ceart gu leòr. 'S e eucoir a th' ann an ealain leamh.

column1: Every control with a ~ beside it can follow an oscillator. Press one. The knob starts to breathe.
column2: Faodaidh smachd sam bith le ~ ri thaobh oscillator a leantainn. Brùth fear. Tòisichidh am putan ag anail.

column1: A low-frequency oscillator: slow, so the eye can follow it. A quarter of a hertz is a four-second breath.
column2: Oscillator tricead ìosal: slaodach, gus an lean an t-sùil e. 'S e anail ceithir diogan a th' ann an cairteal de hertz.

column1: Now it MOVES. Okay. Okay. I'm listening.
column2: A-nis tha e a' GLUASAD. Ceart. Ceart. Tha mi ag èisteachd.

column1: Effects that draw a colour, like Edges' line, have a colour chip. It opens the picker: a wheel, typed names, or a colour off the screen.
column2: Tha clach-dhatha aig buadhan a tharraingeas dath, mar loidhne Edges. Fosglaidh i an taghadair: cuibhle, ainmean sgrìobhte, no dath bhon sgrìn.

column1: Every colour has a name somewhere. Mine is 'oscilloscope green'. Nobody else uses it.
column2: Tha ainm aig gach dath am badeigin. 'S e 'uaine osgailoscop' a th' air mo fhear-sa. Chan eil duine eile ga chleachdadh.

column1: That colour is doing something. I don't know what. I love it.
column2: Tha an dath sin a' dèanamh rudeigin. Chan eil fhios agam dè. Is toil leam e.

column1: An effect, a ~ and a colour. The critic is crying, skapi. Good crying, I think.
column2: Buaidh, ~ agus dath. Tha am breitheamh a' caoineadh, skapi. Deagh chaoineadh, tha mi a' smaoineachadh.

column1: Stack a few. Each has its own ~ on every knob. That is how a look becomes a performance.
column2: Cuir grunn air muin a chèile. Tha a ~ fhèin aig gach fear air gach putan. Sin mar a bhios coltas na chluich.

column1: It's still a square. But it's YOUR square. Post it.
column2: 'S e ceàrnag a th' ann fhathast. Ach 's e DO cheàrnag-sa a th' ann. Cuir suas e.

column1: Coach Marv explains sport by drawing circles on it. Once he circled the sun. Ten minutes, skapi.
column2: Mìnichidh Coach Marv spòrs le bhith a' tarraing chearcall air. Aon turas chuir e cearcall timcheall na grèine. Deich mionaidean, skapi.

column1: Tonight: test patterns, the video synth, and drawing on the picture. Press START.
column2: A-nochd: dealbhan deuchainn, an synth bhidio, agus tarraing air an dealbh. Brùth START.

column1: Get me a picture and a pen. BOOM.
column2: Thoir dhomh dealbh agus peann. BÙM.

column1: Line up the screens BEFORE the show. Not during. I learned this in Plovdiv.
column2: Cuir na sgrìnichean ann an loidhne MUS tòisich an taisbeanadh. Chan ann rè. Dh'ionnsaich mi sin ann am Plovdiv.

column1: Every desk needs a test pattern. PATTERN adds Pocket Test: checked against real meters.
column2: Feumaidh gach deasg dealbh deuchainn. Cuiridh DEALBH DEUCHAINN Pocket Test ris: air a dhearbhadh le fìor mheidheachan.

column1: He says 'no camera needed' like it is a feature. It is a feature.
column2: Tha e ag ràdh 'chan fheum thu camara' mar gur e feart a th' ann. 'S e feart a th' ann.

column1: My favourite. SOURCE, then Video Synth: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. No camera needed.
column2: Am fear as fheàrr leam. TÙS, an uairsin Video Synth: oscillators, sgàthanan agus ais-bhiadhadh. Chan fheum thu camara.

column1: Select it, then TAKE. Confident operators press Enter.
column2: Tagh e, an uairsin TAKE. Brùthaidh luchd-obrachaidh misneachail Enter.

column1: That's our replay. Every replay needs a pundit.
column2: Sin an ath-chluich againn. Feumaidh gach ath-chluich eòlaiche.

column1: Now here's a replay. And here's a guy. And BOOM, he's in it.
column2: Seo an ath-chluich. Seo an cluicheadair. Agus BÙM, tha e innte.

column1: Ink goes on top, on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Thèid inc air a' mhullach, air an t-sreath aice fhèin. Brùth an + aig deireadh tabaichean nan liostaichean-cluich.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the first. Like a second oscillator, mixed on top.
column2: 'S e sreath os cionn a' chiad tè a th' ann an dara liosta. Mar dhara oscillator, measgaichte air a' mhullach.

column1: In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Draw. Clear everywhere you have not drawn.
column2: Anns an liosta ùr: TÙS, an uairsin Draw. Trìd-shoilleir anns gach àite far nach do tharraing thu.

column1: A Draw cue is transparent outside the ink, so the synth shows through.
column2: Tha cue Draw trìd-shoilleir taobh a-muigh na h-inc, mar sin chithear an synth troimhe.

column1: Select the Draw cue and TAKE it. Two playlists, two layers, one picture.
column2: Tagh an cue Draw agus dèan TAKE. Dà liosta, dà shreath, aon dealbh.

column1: Now both are live: the synth underneath, the ink on top.
column2: A-nis tha an dithis air an adhar: an synth fodha, an inc air a' mhullach.

column1: Press DRAW in the inspector, then draw on the programme monitor. Mouse, or a pen if you have one.
column2: Brùth DRAW san inspector, an uairsin tarraing air monitor a' phrògraim. Le luchag, no peann ma tha fear agad.

column1: A pen's pressure makes the line thicker. A mouse presses at one strength. Like me.
column2: Nì cuideam a' phinn an loidhne nas tiugha. Brùthaidh luchag an-còmhnaidh aig an aon neart. Coltach rium-sa.

column1: Circle him! No, bigger. BOOM. That's a cloud. Fine. Circle the cloud.
column2: Cuir cearcall timcheall air! Chan e, nas motha. BÙM. Sin sgòth. Ceart. Cuir cearcall timcheall air an sgòth.

column1: SAVE STILL keeps the drawing as a picture with a clear background, and adds it to the playlist.
column2: Cumaidh SAVE STILL an dealbh mar ìomhaigh le cùl-raon trìd-shoilleir, agus cuiridh e ris an liosta i.

column1: For next week's show. Coach Marv will want the cloud again.
column2: Airson prògram na h-ath sheachdain. Bidh Coach Marv ag iarraidh an sgòth a-rithist.

column1: Patterns, the synth, a layer, ink, a still. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Pàtranan, an synth, sreath, inc, dealbh-stad. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: Try Replay in the Draw section: it draws your lines back the way you drew them.
column2: Feuch Replay ann an earrann Draw: tarraingidh e na loidhnichean agad a-rithist mar a tharraing thu iad.

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen. And a turducken.
column2: An aon àm an ath sheachdain. Thoir peann nas motha leat. Agus mias cranachan.

column1: The Bureau of Unexplained Signals. Two agents, one photo, and it must not air. Press START.
column2: Biùro nan Comharran gun Mhìneachadh. Dà àidseant, aon dealbh, agus chan fhaod e a dhol air an adhar. Brùth START.

column1: Masks cut a picture into shapes. Tonight we cut evidence.
column2: Gearraidh masgaichean dealbh na chumaidhean. A-nochd gearraidh sinn fianais.

column1: That's a craft, Brandt. Look at the lights. I want to believe.
column2: 'S e soitheach a th' ann, Brandt. Coimhead air na solais. Tha mi airson creidsinn.

column1: In the inspector's MASK section: mask, then 'new heart'. Any shape will do. The heart is funnier.
column2: Ann an earrann MASK an inspector: mask, an uairsin 'new heart'. Nì cumadh sam bith a' chùis. Tha an cridhe nas èibhinne.

column1: The library has circles, stars, hearts. Each one is points you can move.
column2: Tha cearcaill, rionnagan, cridheachan san leabharlann. 'S e puingean a ghabhas gluasad a th' anns gach fear.

column1: A heart, Hollis? The Bureau redacts with black bars.
column2: Cridhe, Hollis? Bidh am Biùro a' falach le bàraichean dubha.

column1: Set the tool to pen, then click round the saucer on the monitor. Click the first point to close it.
column2: Cuir an t-inneal gu peann, an uairsin briog timcheall an t-sàsair air a' mhonitor. Briog air a' chiad phuing airson a dhùnadh.

column1: Click for corners, drag for curves. The way the Bezier brothers intended.
column2: Briog airson oiseanan, slaod airson lùban. Mar a bha bràithrean Bézier an dùil.

column1: Draw round it carefully. It might be watching.
column2: Tarraing timcheall air gu faiceallach. Dh'fhaodadh e a bhith a' coimhead.

column1: Invert keeps the outside and cuts the inside. The saucer goes. The sky stays.
column2: Cumaidh tionndadh an taobh a-muigh agus gearraidh e an taobh a-staigh. Falbhaidh an sàsar. Fanaidh an speur.

column1: The same shape, the other way round. Very useful. Slightly spooky.
column2: An aon chumadh, an taobh eile. Glè fheumail. Beagan uamhasach.

column1: Hollis, there's a heart-shaped hole in the sky.
column2: Hollis, tha toll ann an cumadh cridhe san speur.

column1: Feather softens the edge, so nobody sees the cut. Press + on feather.
column2: Maothaichidh e an oir, gus nach fhaic duine an gearradh. Brùth + air feather.

column1: A hard edge says 'someone was here'. A soft one says nothing at all.
column2: Tha oir chruaidh ag ràdh 'bha cuideigin an seo'. Chan eil oir bhog ag ràdh dad.
Chan fhaigh iad a-mach gu bràth.

column1: A library shape, the pen, invert and feather. The Bureau thanks you. The Bureau was never here.
column2: Cumadh leabharlainn, am peann, tionndadh agus maothachadh. Tha am Biùro taingeil. Cha robh am Biùro an seo a-riamh.

column1: Masks also go on a layer, an output, or its matte: MASK ON chooses. And every control takes a ~.
column2: Thèid masgaichean cuideachd air sreath, às-chur, no am matte aige: taghaidh MASK ON. Agus gabhaidh gach smachd ~.

column1: The truth is in the waveform, Hollis. Next time, the scopes.
column2: Tha an fhìrinn anns a' chruth-tonn, Hollis. An ath thuras, na scopes.

column1: A lighthouse, a ghost, and a keeper who has been alone with the lamp far too long. Press START.
column2: Taigh-solais, taibhse, agus fear-gleidhidh a bha leis fhèin leis an lampa fada ro fhada. Brùth START.

column1: Projection mapping: bending the picture to fit the building. Warp, blend, slices.
column2: Mapadh teilgidh: a' lùbadh an deilbh gus am freagair e an togalach. Lùbadh, measgachadh, sliseagan.

column1: Ye'll be wanting the ghost on the windows. Mind the lamp. The lamp is MINE.
column2: Bidh sibh ag iarraidh an taibhse air na h-uinneagan, a bheil? Thoiribh an aire don lampa. Is ann LEAMSA a tha an lampa.

column1: MENU, then Video Outputs, then Geometry. Where an output's shape lives.
column2: CLÀR, an uairsin Às-chuir bhidio, an uairsin Geoimeatraidh. Sin far a bheil cumadh às-chuir a' fuireach.

column1: Geometry: the projector-menu word for 'what shape is the picture'.
column2: Geoimeatraidh: facal clàr-taice an teilgeadair airson 'dè an cumadh a th' air an dealbh'.

column1: Press warp edit, then drag a corner on the programme monitor. The window is not square. Neither is the keeper.
column2: Brùth warp edit, an uairsin slaod oisean air monitor a' phrògraim. Chan eil an uinneag ceàrnagach. No am fear-gleidhidh.

column1: A corner pin moves the four corners. Perspective keeps the lines straight, like a real window.
column2: Gluaisidh prìne oisein na ceithir oiseanan. Cumaidh sealladh-farsaing na loidhnichean dìreach, mar fhìor uinneag.

column1: LEFT! Ye call that a corner? I've seen straighter gulls.
column2: CLÌ! An e sin oisean dhutsa? Chunna mi faoileagan nas dìriche.

column1: Back in Geometry: edge blend, + on the left and + on the right.
column2: Air ais ann an Geoimeatraidh: edge blend, + air an taobh chlì agus + air an taobh dheas.

column1: Two projectors overlap; each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright.
column2: Tha dà theilgeadair a' dol thairis air a chèile; crìonaidh gach fear an oir aige gus nach bi an tar-laighe dà uair cho soilleir.

column1: Geometry, SLICES, open. The Screens window is where slices are cut and placed.
column2: Geoimeatraidh, SLICES, fosgail. 'S e uinneag Screens far an tèid sliseagan a ghearradh agus a chur.

column1: A slice is a piece of the picture, put anywhere on the output.
column2: 'S e pìos den dealbh a th' ann an sliseag, air a chur àite sam bith air an às-chur.

column1: In the Screens window, + SLICE three times, and drag each crop to a third of the picture.
column2: Ann an uinneag Screens, + SLICE trì tursan, agus slaod gach bàrr gu trian den dealbh.

column1: Three windows, three slices: left, middle and right of one picture.
column2: Trì uinneagan, trì sliseagan: clì, meadhan agus deas aon deilbh.

column1: Three windows. The lamp gets the middle one. The lamp ALWAYS gets the middle one.
column2: Trì uinneagan. Gheibh an lampa am fear meadhanach. Gheibh an lampa an-còmhnaidh am fear meadhanach.

column1: Warp, blend, slices. The keeper will finally sleep. The gulls will not.
column2: Lùbadh, measgachadh, sliseagan. Caidlidh am fear-gleidhidh mu dheireadh. Cha chaidil na faoileagan.

column1: Slices have their own warp and mesh in the Screens window. And a ~ on the place and the turn.
column2: Tha an lùbadh agus an lìon aca fhèin aig sliseagan ann an uinneag Screens. Agus ~ air an àite agus an tionndadh.

column1: Ye did alright, lad. Now get away from the lamp.
column2: Rinn thu ceart gu leòr, a bhalaich. A-nis, falbh bhon lampa.

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and cues that fire from anywhere. Press START.
column2: Taisbeanadh-geama, skapi. Triùir farpaiseach, aon bhuzzer, agus cues a loisgeas bho àite sam bith. Brùth START.

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines. Like a sequencer you can play from any key.
column2: Àireamhan cue, iuchraichean-goirid, agus GO bho innealan eile. Mar sequencer a chluicheas tu bho iuchair sam bith.

column1: Welcome to the show! Let's spin that wheel!
column2: Fàilte chun an taisbeanaidh! Cuiribh car air a' chuibhle sin!

column1: Contestant 3 is selected. In the inspector's metadata, give it a cue number: 3.
column2: Tha Farpaiseach 3 air a thaghadh. Ann am metadata an inspector, thoir àireamh cue dha: 3.

column1: Theatre numbers its cues. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: Bidh an taigh-cluiche a' cur àireamhan air na cues aige. Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Leughaidh Deckboy iad uile.

column1: I'd like to buy a number, please.
column2: Bu toil leam àireamh a cheannach, ma 's e do thoil e.

column1: Ctrl+G, type the number, Enter. It goes live wherever the list happens to be standing.
column2: Ctrl+G, sgrìobh an àireamh, Enter. Thèid e air an adhar, ge be càite a bheil an liosta na seasamh.

column1: GOTO. The fastest way across a long list. Faster than scrolling. Much faster than me.
column2: GOTO. An t-slighe as luaithe ann an liosta fhada. Nas luaithe na sgroladh. Fada nas luaithe na mise.

column1: Contestant 1 is selected. In TRIGGERS, press key, then F5. That key now fires this cue.
column2: Tha Farpaiseach 1 air a thaghadh. Ann an TRIGGERS, brùth key, an uairsin F5. Loisgidh an iuchair sin an cue seo a-nis.

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one, a buzzer.
column2: F1 gu F10, F12, no am pada àireamhan. Gach tè, buzzer.

column1: Press the key. The cue fires, wherever the list is standing.
column2: Brùth an iuchair. Loisgidh an cue, ge be càite a bheil an liosta na seasamh.

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Just the key.
column2: Gun luchag, gun liosta, gun choimhead. Dìreach an iuchair.

column1: Companion, a MIDI note, an OSC message: MENU, then Network, says where each one connects.
column2: Companion, nòta MIDI, teachdaireachd OSC: CLÀR, an uairsin Lìonra, ag innse càite an ceangail gach fear.

column1: A Stream Deck in the next room can press GO. So can a keyboard synth. I prefer the synth.
column2: Faodaidh Stream Deck san ath rùm GO a bhrùthadh. Agus synth meur-chlàir cuideachd. B' fheàrr leam an synth.

column1: And for our viewers at home: you can play along too.
column2: Agus don luchd-coimhead aig an taigh: faodaidh sibhse cluich cuideachd.

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You are a game show now, skapi.
column2: Àireamhan, GOTO, buzzer, agus GO bho àite sam bith. Is e taisbeanadh-geama a th' annad a-nis, skapi.

column1: A cue can have a key, a MIDI note and an OSC address at once. Belt, braces and a second belt.
column2: Faodaidh iuchair, nòta MIDI agus seòladh OSC a bhith aig cue aig an aon àm. Crios, galasaichean agus dara crios.
Oidhche mhath, a h-uile duine! Cumaibh a' cur car!

column1: Channel 6 weather, skapi. A map, a presenter, and a very large lizard. Press START.
column2: Aimsir Seanal 6, skapi. Mapa, preasantair, agus dearc-luachrach glè mhòr. Uisge, a rèir coltais, mar as àbhaist. Brùth START.

column1: Words on screen: Lower Thirds, text, and backdrops.
column2: Faclan air an sgrìn: bannan-ainm, teacsa, agus cùl-raointean.

column1: I'm June O'Neil, and nothing about this forecast is normal.
column2: Is mise June O'Neil, agus chan eil dad mun ro-aithris seo àbhaisteach.

column1: Words go on their own layer: press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Thèid faclan air an t-sreath aca fhèin: brùth an + aig deireadh tabaichean nan liostaichean-cluich.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. Mostly.
column2: 'S e sreath os cionn a' mhapa a th' anns an dara liosta. Fanaidh an dearc-luachrach fodha. Mar as trice.

column1: Words on top. Always on top.
column2: Faclan air a' mhullach. An-còmhnaidh air a' mhullach.

column1: In the new playlist: SOURCE, then Lower Third.
column2: Anns an liosta ùr: TÙS, an uairsin Lower Third.

column1: A name and a title, low on the screen, out of the lizard's way.
column2: Ainm agus tiotal, ìosal air an sgrìn, a-mach à rathad an dearc-luachrach.

column1: In the inspector, title: type the presenter's name. The second line is her job.
column2: Anns an inspector, title: sgrìobh ainm a' phreasantair. 'S e an dàrna loidhne an obair aice.

column1: Spelling counts. The audience reads it at the speed of light.
column2: Tha litreachadh cudromach. Leughaidh an luchd-èisteachd aig astar an t-solais.

column1: Spell it right. Last week it said 'Jane O'Meal'.
column2: Litrich e ceart. An t-seachdain sa chaidh bha 'June Nic Néill' air.

column1: TAKE the Lower Third. Her name slides in over the map.
column2: TAKE am bann-ainm. Sleamhnaichidh an t-ainm aice a-steach thairis air a' mhapa.

column1: Two layers live: the weather, and the words on top of it.
column2: Dà shreath air an adhar: an aimsir, agus na faclan os a cionn.

column1: Thank you. Now, about that lizard...
column2: Tapadh leat. A-nis, mun dearc-luachrach sin...

column1: SOURCE, then Text: a title card. Then its backdrop chip: key green, for the vision mixer to key out.
column2: TÙS, an uairsin Text: cairt-tiotail. An uairsin a clach cùl-raoin: uaine iuchrach, gus an iuchraich am measgaire e a-mach.

column1: A backdrop fills behind the words. Key green or key blue, and the mixer does the rest.
column2: Lìonaidh cùl-raon air cùl nam facal. Uaine no gorm iuchrach, agus nì am measgaire an còrr.

column1: Breaking news: it's standing on the five-day forecast.
column2: Naidheachd ùr: tha e na sheasamh air an ro-aithris còig latha.

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio, skapi.
column2: Bann-ainm, ainm, cairt-tiotail, cùl-raon. Dh'fhàg an dearc-luachrach an stiùidio, skapi.

column1: Lower Thirds can wait, slide and leave on their own. Their section has every setting.
column2: Faodaidh bannan-ainm feitheamh, sleamhnachadh agus falbh leotha fhèin. Tha a h-uile roghainn san earrann aca.

column1: That's the weather. Back to you, guys. Run.
column2: Sin an aimsir. Air ais gun stiùidio. Ruithibh. Agus thoiribh cleòc-uisge.

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, and an inventor who wants cheese. Press START.
column2: Rocaid air a togail ann an seilear, skapi, agus innleadair a tha ag iarraidh càise. Brùth START.

column1: Stage timers: countdowns, clocks, and a presenter view for the person on stage.
column2: Uaireadairean àrd-ùrlair: cunntaidhean sìos, gleocan, agus sealladh preasantair don neach air an àrd-ùrlar.

column1: Cheese, Grommet! The moon's made of it. We'll need a countdown.
column2: Càise, Grommet! Tha a' ghealach air a dèanamh dheth. Feumaidh sinn cunntadh sìos.

column1: SOURCE, then Stage Timer. A clock that counts down, in big friendly numbers.
column2: TÙS, an uairsin Stage Timer. Gleoc a chunntas air ais, ann an àireamhan mòra càirdeil.

column1: Its colours change as it runs out: white, amber, red. Like a VU meter for time.
column2: Atharraichidh na dathan aige mar a ruitheas an ùine a-mach: geal, òmar, dearg. Mar VU meter airson ùine.

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. The countdown starts.
column2: Tagh an t-uaireadair agus dèan TAKE. Tòisichidh an cunntadh.

column1: Past zero it keeps going, counting the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: Às dèidh neoni cumaidh e a' dol, a' cunntadh an ùine a bharrachd. Glè onarach. Beagan mì-mhodhail.

column1: Ten... nine... ooh, I do love a countdown.
column2: Deich... naoi... ò, is toil leam cunntadh sìos.

column1: Something's loose! Space holds the countdown. The clock shows it is held.
column2: Tha rudeigin fuasgailte! Cumaidh am bàr-fànais an cunntadh. Seallaidh an gleoc gu bheil e air a chumail.

column1: A hold is not a stop. Space again, and it carries on from where it was.
column2: Chan e stad a th' ann an cumail. Am bàr-fànais a-rithist, agus leanaidh e bhon àite far an robh e.

column1: MENU, Video Outputs: make an output's type PRESENTER. The person on stage gets the timer, the next cue and their notes.
column2: CLÀR, Às-chuir bhidio: dèan seòrsa às-chuir PRESENTER. Gheibh an neach air an àrd-ùrlar an t-uaireadair, an ath cue agus na notaichean aca.

column1: A presenter view is an output like any other. Point it at the confidence monitor.
column2: 'S e às-chur coltach ri gin eile a th' ann an sealladh preasantair. Stiùir e chun a' mhonitor misneachd.

column1: So the pilot can see the time. The pilot is Grommet.
column2: Gus am faic am pìolota an uair. 'S e Grommet am pìolota.

column1: A countdown, a hold, and a view for the pilot. Nazdrave, skapi. Bring crackers.
column2: Cunntadh sìos, cumail, agus sealladh don phìolota. Nazdrave, skapi. Thoir briosgaidean.

column1: Timers can also count up, or show the time of day. Their section has the lot.
column2: Faodaidh uaireadairean cunntadh suas cuideachd, no uair an latha a shealltainn. Tha a h-uile càil san earrann aca.

column1: A grand day out, Grommet! Pass the crackers.
column2: Latha mòr a-muigh, Grommet! Sìn thugam na briosgaidean.

column1: A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a prop, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: Taisbeanadh draoidheachd, skapi. Ciste, prop, agus aon bhuille far an atharraich a h-uile càil aig an aon àm. Brùth START.

column1: Two playlists are two layers. TAKE ALL changes both together.
column2: 'S e dà shreath a th' ann an dà liosta. Atharraichidh TAKE ALL an dà chuid còmhla.

column1: Every trick needs two things happening at once. And a rubber chicken.
column2: Feumaidh gach cleas dà rud a' tachairt aig an aon àm. Agus cearc rubair.

column1: The prop goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Thèid am prop air an t-sreath aige fhèin. Brùth an + aig deireadh tabaichean nan liostaichean-cluich.

column1: Playlist 2 sits on top of playlist 1. Like a transparency on an overhead projector.
column2: Suidhidh liosta 2 air muin liosta 1. Mar thrìd-shoilleireachd air teilgeadair os-cionn.

column1: Nothing up my sleeve. Everything in my trunk.
column2: Chan eil dad nam mhuinchill. A h-uile càil nam chiste.

column1: In the new playlist, add anything: PATTERN will do. That is the prop.
column2: Anns an liosta ùr, cuir rud sam bith ris: nì DEALBH DEUCHAINN a' chùis. Sin am prop.

column1: Whatever it is, it will appear the instant the trunk opens.
column2: Ge be dè a th' ann, nochdaidh e an dearbh mhionaid a dh'fhosglas a' chiste.

column1: Is it a rubber chicken? It's always a rubber chicken.
column2: An e cearc rubair a th' ann? 'S e cearc rubair a th' ann an-còmhnaidh.

column1: Select 'The trunk (open)' in playlist 1 and the prop in playlist 2. Then TAKE ALL: both on one beat.
column2: Tagh 'A' chiste (fosgailte)' ann an liosta 1 agus am prop ann an liosta 2. An uairsin TAKE ALL: an dà chuid air aon bhuille.

column1: One press, every playlist's selected cue. The audience never sees the seam.
column2: Aon bhrùthadh, cue taghte gach liosta. Chan fhaic an luchd-èisteachd an t-uaim gu bràth.

column1: Two layers, one beat. Every playlist has its own opacity and can sit on any output. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Dà shreath, aon bhuille. Tha a neo-thrìd-shoilleireachd fhèin aig gach liosta agus faodaidh i suidhe air às-chur sam bith. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: A magician never reveals. A playlist never minds being revealed.
column2: Cha nochd draoidh a dhìomhaireachd gu bràth. Chan eil diofar aig liosta ma tha i air a nochdadh.

column1: Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: Tapadh leibh! Tha mi an seo fad na seachdain! Tha a' chearc an seo gu bràth.

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. Everything is on fire. Press START.
column2: Taisbeanadh còcaireachd, skapi. Beò. Tha a h-uile càil na theine. Brùth START.

column1: BLACK hides the picture and keeps the show running. PANIC stops everything. Know which you need.
column2: Falaichidh BLACK an dealbh agus cumaidh e an taisbeanadh a' ruith. Stadaidh PANIC a h-uile càil. Biodh fios agad dè am fear a dh'fheumas tu.

column1: Bork bork! Hurdy-flurdy, de kitchen is fire-a-flurdy!
column2: Bork bork! Hurdy-flurdy, tha an cidsin na theine-flurdy!

column1: The audience must not see this. Press BLACK, or B.
column2: Chan fhaod an luchd-èisteachd seo fhaicinn. Brùth BLACK, no B.

column1: The picture goes. The cue keeps playing underneath, ready to come back.
column2: Falbhaidh an dealbh. Cumaidh an cue a' cluich fodha, deiseil airson tilleadh.

column1: Bork? Bork. Oh, de picture is gun.
column2: Bork? Bork. O, tha an dealbh air falbh.

column1: The fire's out. Press B again: the picture comes back, still running.
column2: Tha an teine às. Brùth B a-rithist: thig an dealbh air ais, fhathast a' ruith.

column1: Nothing was lost. A mute on a mixer, for pictures.
column2: Cha deach dad air chall. Mute air measgaire, airson dealbhan.

column1: Worse: MENU, System, the SAFETY card: PANIC. Everything stops, the way the panic setting says.
column2: Nas miosa: CLÀR, Siostam, a' chairt SAFETY: PANIC. Stadaidh a h-uile càil, mar a tha roghainn a' chlisgidh ag ràdh.

column1: PANIC is the big red button. Use it when BLACK is not enough. Then breathe.
column2: 'S e PANIC am putan mòr dearg. Cleachd e nuair nach leòr BLACK. An uairsin tarraing anail.

column1: Close MENU, select the souffle, and TAKE it. The show is back on.
column2: Dùin CLÀR, tagh an soufflé, agus dèan TAKE. Tha an taisbeanadh a' dol a-rithist.

column1: After a panic, the show is still there. Pick up where you meant to be.
column2: Às dèidh clisgeadh, tha an taisbeanadh ann fhathast. Lean ort bhon àite far an robh thu airson a bhith.

column1: Voila! De souffle, he is risen!
BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen, skapi.
column2: BLACK airson falach, PANIC airson stad, TAKE airson tilleadh. Mairidh tu beò ann an cidsin sam bith, skapi.

column1: The panic setting chooses what PANIC does: fade out, cut, or just the outputs.
column2: Taghaidh roghainn a' chlisgidh na nì PANIC: crìonadh a-mach, gearradh, no dìreach na h-às-chuir.

column1: Presets, skapi. A whole look, remembered, and back with one button. Press START.
column2: Ro-shuidheachaidhean, skapi. Coltas slàn, air a chuimhneachadh, agus air ais le aon phutan. Brùth START.

column1: Like the patch memory on a synth: store, then recall.
column2: Mar chuimhne patch air synth: stòir, an uairsin gairm air ais.

column1: Press DASH: buttons of your own, for anything at all.
column2: Brùth DASH: putanan agad fhèin, airson rud sam bith.

column1: Ctrl+D also works. Very fast. Very professional.
column2: Obraichidh Ctrl+D cuideachd. Glè luath. Glè phroifeiseanta.

column1: Press +, then 'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. The button remembers this look.
column2: Brùth +, an uairsin 'preset - a new preset from what is on now'. Cuimhnichidh am putan an coltas seo.

column1: Store. Like saving the patch before the drummer leans on the synth.
column2: Stòir. Mar a bhith a' sàbhaladh a' phatch mus lùb an drumair air an synth.

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it. A different look.
column2: Dùin an DASH (Esc), an uairsin tagh Coltas a dhà agus dèan TAKE. Coltas eile.

column1: Change it all. Don't worry. It remembers.
column2: Atharraich a h-uile càil. Na gabh dragh. Cuimhnichidh e.

column1: Open the DASH and press your preset button. The first look comes back.
column2: Fosgail an DASH agus brùth am putan ro-shuidheachaidh agad. Thig a' chiad choltas air ais.

column1: Recall. The patch memory, returning. Beautiful.
column2: Gairm air ais. Cuimhne a' phatch, a' tilleadh. Brèagha.

column1: A look, stored and recalled. A preset can keep cues, positions, effects, levels and routing; its button's menu chooses which.
column2: Coltas, air a stòradh is air a ghairm air ais. Cumaidh ro-shuidheachadh cues, àiteachan, buadhan, ìrean agus slighean; taghaidh clàr a' phutain aige cò iad.

column1: And a DASH button can run any command at all. Any. Even the exciting ones.
column2: Agus faodaidh putan DASH àithne sam bith a ruith. Gin sam bith. Fiù 's an fheadhainn inntinneach.

column1: A space-opera trailer, skapi. A narrator with a very deep voice and opinions about transitions. Press START.
column2: Tràilear opara-fànais, skapi. Aithrisiche le guth glè dhomhainn agus beachdan air gluasadan. Brùth START.

column1: A transition is how one cue becomes the next. There are far more than the crossfade.
column2: 'S e gluasad mar a thèid aon cue gu bhith na ath fhear. Tha fada a bharrachd ann na crossfade.

column1: In a galaxy of content... one operator... must choose a transition.
column2: Ann an reul-chrios de shusbaint... feumaidh aon neach-obrachaidh... gluasad a thaghadh.

column1: 'The planet' is selected. In the inspector, its transition style: choose iris.
column2: Tha 'Am planaid' air a thaghadh. Anns an inspector, stoidhle a ghluasaid: tagh iris.

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white. Even a portal. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: Putaidhean, sguabaidhean, iris, dup gu geal. Fiù 's portal. Sgrìobh mi an leth dhiubh. Air Dimàirt.

column1: The planet deserves... a dramatic entrance.
column2: Tha am planaid airidh air... teachd a-steach drùidhteach.

column1: Give it a time: + on transition until it says a second or more.
column2: Thoir ùine dha: + air gluasad gus an can e diog no barrachd.

column1: No time, no transition. A style needs a duration to do anything at all.
column2: Gun ùine, gun ghluasad. Feumaidh stoidhle fad-ùine gus dad a dhèanamh.

column1: TAKE the planet. Watch it arrive.
column2: TAKE am planaid. Coimhead air a' tighinn.

column1: The transition belongs to the cue arriving. Each cue chooses its own entrance.
column2: Buinidh an gluasad don cue a tha a' tighinn. Taghaidh gach cue a theachd a-steach fhèin.

column1: Now 'The battle': choose shatter, give it a time, and TAKE it.
column2: A-nis 'Am blàr': tagh shatter, thoir ùine dha, agus dèan TAKE.

column1: Shatter drops the old picture like a pane of glass. Please do not do this at a funeral.
column2: Leigidh bristeadh an seann dealbh sìos mar phana glainne. Feuch nach dèan sibh seo aig tòrradh.

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Nazdrave, skapi.
column2: Stoidhle, ùine, agus dà theachd a-steach glè dhrùidhteach. Nazdrave, skapi.

column1: A playlist has a default style too, for every cue that does not choose its own.
column2: Tha stoidhle bhunaiteach aig liosta cuideachd, airson gach cue nach tagh a fhèin.

column1: Coming soon... to a desk near you.
column2: A' tighinn a dh'aithghearr... gu deasg faisg ort.

column1: Two robot DJs, skapi. They do not talk. Their helmets do. Press START.
column2: Dà DJ inneil, skapi. Cha bhruidhinn iad. Bruidhnidh na clogaidean aca. Brùth START.

column1: Every cue has its own chain of audio effects, and some of them break the sound on purpose.
column2: Tha a sreath fhèin de bhuadhan fuaim aig gach cue, agus brisidh cuid dhiubh am fuaim a dh'aona ghnothach.

column1: > HELLO. WE ARE HERE TO FIX YOUR MIX.
column2: > HALÒ. THA SINN AN SEO GUS DO MHEASGACHADH A CHÀRADH.

column1: The beat is selected. In its AUDIO EFFECTS section, + adds one. Try the delay.
column2: Tha a' bhuille air a taghadh. Anns an earrann AUDIO EFFECTS aice, cuiridh + tè ris. Feuch an delay.

column1: Delay, reverb, filters, a compressor. Amount always means 'less of this'.
column2: Dàil, ath-fhuaim, sìoltachain, compressor. Tha meud an-còmhnaidh a' ciallachadh 'nas lugha de seo'.

column1: > ONE MORE TIME. WITH ECHO. ECHO. ECHO.
column2: > AON TURAS EILE. LE MAC-TALLA. MAC-TALLA. MAC-TALLA.

column1: Add a second: a bend, like crush. It damages the sound the way a broken file would.
column2: Cuir dàrna tè ris: lùb, mar crush. Millidh e am fuaim mar a dhèanadh faidhle briste.

column1: The bends are my favourite. Like a tape left in the sun. On purpose.
column2: 'S iad na lùban an fheadhainn as fheàrr leam. Mar theip air fhàgail sa ghrèin. A dh'aona ghnothach.
> NAS CRUAIDHE. NAS FHEÀRR. NAS CRIOSLAICHE. NAS ÀIRDE.

column1: MENU, then Audio: where each playlist's sound goes, and the patch for named outputs.
column2: CLÀR, an uairsin Fuaim: far an tèid fuaim gach liosta, agus am patch airson às-chuir ainmichte.

column1: Speakers, monitors, an in-ear for the drummer. The patch sends each its own.
column2: Labhradairean, monitors, in-ear don drumair. Cuiridh am patch a chuid fhèin gu gach fear.

column1: > AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX. AROUND THE MIX.
column2: > TIMCHEALL A' MHEASGACHAIDH. TIMCHEALL A' MHEASGACHAIDH. TIMCHEALL A' MHEASGACHAIDH.

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, skapi. I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: Buaidh, lùb agus am patch. Tha na h-innealan riaraichte, skapi. Tha mi a' smaoineachadh. 'S e clogaidean a th' anns na h-aodainn aca.

column1: Every audio effect can follow a ~ too, even Motion. Wave at the delay. It's wonderful.
column2: Faodaidh gach buaidh fuaim ~ a leantainn cuideachd, fiù 's Motion. Smèid ris an dàil. Tha e iongantach.

column1: > THANK YOU. GOOD NIGHT. WE ARE ROBOTS.
column2: > TAPADH LEIBH. OIDHCHE MHATH. 'S E ROBOTAN A TH' ANNAINN.

column1: The Bureau again, skapi. A glow on the horizon, and two agents who disagree about it. Press START.
column2: Am Biùro a-rithist, skapi. Deàrrsadh air fàire, agus dà àidseant nach eil ag aontachadh mu dheidhinn. Brùth START.

column1: The scopes measure a picture: brightness, colour, levels. Numbers, not opinions.
column2: Tomhaisidh na scopes dealbh: soilleireachd, dath, ìrean. Àireamhan, chan e beachdan.

column1: It's them, Brandt. It's a craft. Look how it glows.
column2: 'S iad-san a th' ann, Brandt. 'S e soitheach a th' ann. Coimhead mar a tha e a' deàrrsadh.

column1: The scopes read only what really goes out, never a preview. Turn the output on: MENU, Video Outputs, OUTPUT OFF.
column2: Cha leugh na scopes ach na thèid a-mach dha-rìribh, ro-shealladh gu bràth. Cuir an t-às-chur air: CLÀR, Às-chuir bhidio, ÀS-CHUR DHETH.

column1: Measuring a scaled-down preview would be measuring a photocopy. We measure the original.
column2: Bhiodh tomhas ro-shealladh air a lùghdachadh mar tomhas lethbhreac. Tomhaisidh sinne an tùsail.

column1: Chain of evidence, Hollis. The real signal or nothing.
column2: Sreath na fianais, Hollis. An fhìor chomharra no dad.

column1: Close MENU. Above the monitor, the PROGRAM button: press it until it says SCOPES or BOTH.
column2: Dùin CLÀR. Os cionn a' mhonitor, am putan PROGRAM: brùth e gus an can e SCOPES no BOTH.

column1: Both shows the picture and its scopes side by side. Very civilised.
column2: Seallaidh BOTH an dealbh agus na scopes aige taobh ri taobh. Glè shìobhalta.
Leig leis na scopes co-dhùnadh, Hollis.

column1: Click the waveform to make it big. Bright things sit high, dark things low, left to right as in the picture.
column2: Briog air a' chruth-tonn gus a dhèanamh mòr. Suidhidh rudan soilleir àrd, rudan dorcha ìosal, clì gu deas mar san dealbh.

column1: The glow is that spike near the top. Very bright. Bright is not the same as alien.
column2: 'S e an deàrrsadh am binnean sin faisg air a' mhullach. Glè shoilleir. Chan ionann soilleir agus coigreach.

column1: Look at the peak. Nothing a streetlight couldn't do.
column2: Coimhead air a' bhinnean. Dad nach b' urrainn do lampa-sràide a dhèanamh.

column1: Click it again to go back, then click the vectorscope: colour round a circle. Saturated runs to the edge.
column2: Briog air a-rithist gus tilleadh, an uairsin briog air an vectorscope: dath timcheall air cearcall. Ruithidh làn-dath chun na h-oire.

column1: Magenta, far out by the rim. A strong colour. Strong is not illegal. Yet.
column2: Magenta, fada a-muigh ris an oir. Dath làidir. Chan eil làidir mì-laghail. Fhathast.

column1: It's off the chart, Brandt! Literally off the chart!
column2: Tha e far a' chairt, Brandt! Gu litireil far a' chairt!

column1: And false colour: red is clipped, yellow nearly. Is the glow red?
column2: Agus dath meallta: tha dearg air a ghearradh, buidhe cha mhòr. A bheil an deàrrsadh dearg?

column1: Clipped means the brightest the signal can carry, and then some lost. Detail gone.
column2: Tha air a ghearradh a' ciallachadh an rud as soilleire as urrainn don chomharra a ghiùlan, agus beagan os a chionn air chall. Am mion-fhiosrachadh air falbh.

column1: Red. Clipped. Not alien, Hollis. Just too bright. Case closed.
column2: Dearg. Air a ghearradh. Chan e coigreach, Hollis. Dìreach ro shoilleir. Cùis dùinte.

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it, skapi. The agents did not.
column2: Cruth-tonn, vectorscope, dath meallta. Shocraich na scopes e, skapi. Cha do shocraich na h-àidseantan.

column1: SCOPES SOURCE reads any output, and the matrix can be 709 or 2020. For the curious.
column2: Leughaidh SCOPES SOURCE às-chur sam bith, agus faodaidh am matrix a bhith 709 no 2020. Dhaibhsan a tha fiosrach.

column1: Too bright for a streetlight, Brandt. Too bright for anything. ...I want to believe.
column2: Ro shoilleir airson lampa-sràide, Brandt. Ro shoilleir airson rud sam bith. ...Tha mi airson creidsinn.

column1: Pictures that leave by cable or network, skapi, not only a window on a screen. Press START.
column2: Dealbhan a dh'fhàgas le càball no lìonra, skapi, chan e dìreach uinneag air sgrìn. Brùth START.

column1: NDI over the network, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.
column2: NDI thar an lìonra, SDI bho chairt DeckLink, ST 2110 airson ionadan craolaidh.

column1: MENU, Video Outputs, then Devices: every way an output can leave this computer.

column1: Each one says whether this machine can do it, and what it needs if not.
column2: Tha gach fear ag ràdh an urrainn don inneal seo a dhèanamh, agus dè a dh'fheumas e mura h-urrainn.

column1: If this computer has NDI, switch NDI SENDING on: the picture is on the network. If not, SHOW ME moves on.
column2: Ma tha NDI aig a' choimpiutair seo, cuir NDI SENDING air: tha an dealbh air an lìonra. Mura h-eil, gluaisidh SHOW ME air adhart.

column1: NDI finds itself on the network. No cables, only a good switch and patience.
column2: Lorgaidh NDI e fhèin air an lìonra. Gun chàballan, dìreach deagh shuidse agus foighidinn.

column1: The output's own page has the rest: a DeckLink card's SDI, ST 2110 with NMOS, Spout and Syphon.
column2: Tha an còrr air duilleag an às-chuir fhèin: SDI cairt DeckLink, ST 2110 le NMOS, Spout agus Syphon.

column1: Every one is just an output. The show does not know or care how it leaves.
column2: Chan eil ann an gin dhiubh ach às-chur. Chan eil fios no diù aig an taisbeanadh ciamar a dh'fhàgas e.

column1: The bridge of the starship Cathode, skapi. Four feeds, one main viewer, one mystery. Press START.
column2: Drochaid an long-fànais Cathode, skapi. Ceithir biadhan, aon phrìomh sgrìn, aon dìomhaireachd. Brùth START.

column1: The multiview shows every playlist at once. Like a wall of oscilloscopes, but in space.
column2: Seallaidh an ioma-shealladh gach liosta aig an aon àm. Mar bhalla de osgailoscopan, ach san fhànais.

column1: Frequencies open, Captain. All of them. That's the problem.

column2: Aon uinneag gach liosta, am prògram an toiseach.

column1: Jinkys! Four feeds. And one of them has a monster in it.
column2: Jinkys! Ceithir biadhan. Agus tha uilebheist ann an tè dhiubh.

column2: Cuir uinneag ris (+), an uairsin an clàr ... aice: thoir oirre NEXT a shealltainn. Na thèid air an adhar nuair a bhrùthas tu TAKE.

column1: Every window has a ... button. It chooses what that window shows.
column2: Tha putan ... aig gach uinneag. Taghaidh e na sheallas an uinneag sin.

column1: I need to see who's calling before they reach the main viewer.
column2: Feumaidh mi faicinn cò tha a' gairm mus ruig iad am prìomh sgrìn.

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late. Mostly.
column2: Agus aon uinneag eile, a' sealltainn a' ghleoc. Cha bhi luchd-obrachaidh a choimheadas air gleoc fadalach gu bràth. Mar as trice.

column1: Time of day, big. Stardates are just very long timecode.
column2: Uair an latha, mòr. Chan eil ann an cinn-latha reultach ach timecode glè fhada.

column1: The monster only shows up at midnight. We're going to need a clock.
column2: Cha nochd an uilebheist ach aig meadhan-oidhche. Feumaidh sinn gleoc.

column1: Any window's ... menu, then a layout: one big, the rest small.
column2: Clàr ... uinneag sam bith, an uairsin cruth: aon tè mhòr, an còrr beag.

column1: The big window is window one. Usually the programme. Usually.
column2: 'S e an uinneag mhòr uinneag a h-aon. Am prògram mar as trice. Mar as trice.

column1: Main viewer big. The captain likes it big.
column2: Prìomh sgrìn mòr. Is toil leis a' chaiptean e mòr.

column1: Select Deck 3 in playlist 3 and TAKE. Watch its window.
column2: Tagh Deic 3 ann an liosta 3 agus dèan TAKE. Coimhead air an uinneag aige.

column1: The red border is TALLY: the window that is on air. On screen, as they say on starships.
column2: 'S e an oir dhearg TALLY: an uinneag a tha air an adhar. Air an sgrìn, mar a chanas iad air longan-fànais.

column1: There! Feed three! Put it on screen!
column2: An siud! Biadh trì! Cuir air an sgrìn e!

column1: Windows, the ... menu, NEXT, the clock, a layout, tally. Mystery solved, skapi.
column2: Uinneagan, an clàr ..., NEXT, an gleoc, cruth, tally. Dìomhaireachd fuasgailte, skapi.

column1: A window can also show an output, with its warp and slices. Handy when it's a lighthouse.
column2: Faodaidh uinneag às-chur a shealltainn cuideachd, leis an lùbadh agus na sliseagan aige. Feumail nuair a tha taigh-solais ann.

column1: And the monster was... the ship's cook, all along. Jinkys.
column2: Agus 's e an uilebheist... còcaire na luinge, fad na h-ùine. Jinkys.

column1: One hand each side. Together! Together!
column2: Aon làmh gach taobh. Còmhla! Còmhla!

column1: Off By One. The bug is not the face, it is the tiny extra segment, and a little wiggle needs a finer reading. Turn SENSITIVITY down to 5%.
column2: Off By One. Chan e an t-aodann a' bhiastag, 's e am pìos beag a bharrachd, agus feumaidh gluasad beag leughadh nas mìne. Cuir SENSITIVITY sìos gu 5%.

column1: Lower number, finer reading. Yes, I also think it is backwards.
column2: Àireamh nas ìsle, leughadh nas mìne. Tha, tha mi a' smaoineachadh gu bheil e air ais-air-adhart cuideachd.

column1: Not the face. The little one on the end. Wiggle a finger.
column2: Chan e an t-aodann. Am fear beag aig an deireadh. Gluais meur.

column1: Memory Leak. It only lets go while the reading stays up. Make FALL longer, 1.5 seconds or more, so your sweeps join up into one.
column2: Memory Leak. Cha leig e às ach fhad 's a dh'fhanas an leughadh suas. Dèan FALL nas fhaide, 1.5 diogan no barrachd, gus an tig na sguabaidhean agad còmhla nan aon.

column1: Sweep, and sweep again. Let the fall carry you between.
column2: Sguab, agus sguab a-rithist. Leig leis an tuiteam do ghiùlan eatarra.

column1: The Heisenbug! It fades whenever you move. Put a tone cue's pitch on Motion X and follow it by ear: the ticking speeds up as you close in.
column2: Am Heisenbug! Crìonaidh e gach uair a ghluaiseas tu. Cuir àirde cue tòna air Motion X agus lean e leis a' chluais: luathaichidh an tic nuair a thig thu nas fhaisge.

column1: Follow it. Listen. Faster ticking, closer bug.

column2: Dè cho fada 's a bheir e a dhol sìos às dèidh an ionnsaigh. Ri chluinntinn a-mhàin le ath-thòiseachadh air.

column1: Off, from start (next cue fires when this one starts) or from end (when it finishes)
column2: Dheth, bhon toiseach (tòisichidh an ath cue nuair a thòisicheas am fear seo) no bhon deireadh (nuair a chrìochnaicheas e)

column1: Height of one line as a percent of the raster, so a card reads the same on any screen
column2: Àirde aon loidhne mar cheudad den raster, gus an leughar cairt mar an ceudna air sgrìn sam bith

column1: Set slot source as media:/path, browser:url, window:name, camera:name, or syphon:name
column2: Suidhich tùs slot mar media:/slighe, browser:url, window:ainm, camera:ainm, no syphon:ainm

column1: Short LFSR mode. The period is brief enough to read as pitched metal rather than hiss.
column2: Modh LFSR goirid. Tha an ùine goirid gu leòr gus fuaim mar mheatailt gleusta seach siosarnaich.

column1: White, warm, red, amber, green, cyan, blue, magenta. ~ moves it round the colour wheel
column2: Geal, blàth, dearg, òmar, uaine, saidhean, gorm, magenta. Gluaisidh ~ e mun cuairt air cuibhle nan dathan

column1: Re-strike the envelope this often. Hold sustains one note, which is what a drone wants.
column2: Buail an cèis a-rithist cho tric seo. Cumaidh Hold aon nòta, nì a tha drone ag iarraidh.

column1: Diamond is the hard-edged Atari Video Music lattice; rings tunnel well with feedback zoom.
column2: 'S e Diamond cliath oir-chruaidh Atari Video Music; nì fàinneachan tunail math le zoom ais-bhiadhaidh.

column1: Rock or spin. Depth 1 is half a turn either way; a saw at depth 1 turns it all the way round
column2: Luasgadh no snìomh. Doimhneachd 1 = leth thionndadh gach taobh; tionndaidhidh sàbh aig 1 e fad na slighe mun cuairt

column1: DECK playback level (live, not saved with the cue) - per-cue trim is gain in the AUDIO section
column2: Ìre cluiche DECK (beò, gun shàbhaladh leis a' cue) - 's e buannachd ann an earrann AUDIO a th' ann an trim gach cue

column1: Still, fade in, typewriter, scroll up, crawl or pulse -- all driven by the cue's own transport
column2: Na stad, fad a-steach, clò-sgrìobhadair, sgrolaich suas, snàigeadh no buille -- uile air an stiùireadh le còmhdhail a' cue fhèin

column1: Fields per rendered frame. 1 is one for one, 0.5 holds each field for two frames, 0 freezes it.
column2: Raointean gach frèam. Tha 1 aon airson aon, cumaidh 0.5 gach raon airson dà fhrèam, reòthaidh 0 e.

column1: What this cue shows while it plays: waveform, scope, Lissajous, spectrum, meters or a name card
column2: Na sheallas an cue seo fhad 's a tha e a' cluich: cruth-tonn, scope, Lissajous, speactram, meatairean no cairt-ainm

column1: 0 picks tiles by brightness so the picture reads. 1 picks at random so the grid becomes texture.
column2: Taghaidh 0 leacan a rèir soilleireachd gus an leughar an dealbh. Taghaidh 1 air thuaiream gus am bi an griod na inneach.

column1: How far it travels, in semitones. Up reads as arrival, down as departure, zero is a struck note.
column2: Dè cho fada 's a shiubhaileas e, ann an leth-thònan. Suas mar ruighinn, sìos mar fhàgail, neoni mar nòta buailte.

column1: An IPv4 address. Names are not resolved: a DNS lookup is a blocking call and GO must not make one
column2: Seòladh IPv4. Chan fhuasglar ainmean: 's e gairm bacaidh a th' ann an lorg DNS agus chan fhaod GO fear a dhèanamh

column1: Tile width in pixels. Must match the sheet's grid or the slices land across neighbouring sprites.
column2: Leud leac ann am piogsail. Feumaidh e griod na duilleig a mhaidseadh, air neo laighidh na sliseagan tarsainn air sprites ri thaobh.

column1: Alternating mirrors by cell position, which reads as pattern where random flipping reads as noise.
column2: Sgàthain mu seach a rèir àite na cealla, a leughas mar phàtran far an leughadh flipeadh air thuaiream mar fhuaim.

column1: 0 welds them to their cell, which reads as engraved. Above it they re-roll, which reads as boiling.
column2: Tàthaidh 0 iad ris a' chealla aca, a leughas mar ghràbhaladh. Os a chionn ath-roilichear iad, a leughas mar ghoil.

column1: MONO L plays the left input in both speakers: mic 1 on most interfaces. STEREO is for a line source.
column2: Cluichidh MONO L an t-inntrigeadh clì anns gach glaodhaire: mic 1 air a' mhòr-chuid. Tha STEREO airson tùs loidhne.

column1: The whole gesture. This IS the cue's duration -- a sting is the one generated signal here that ends.
column2: An gluasad slàn. 'S E seo fad a' cue -- 's e sting an aon siognail gineadh an seo a thig gu crìch.

column1: Click the value to send this fixture or leave it where the last cue put it. ~ makes the level breathe
column2: Briog air an luach gus an inneal seo a chur no fhàgail far an do chuir an cue mu dheireadh e. Nì ~ anail air an ìre

column1: FDS is a wavetable bent by a modulator. 2A03 is the pulse/triangle/noise set most chiptune is made of.
column2: 'S e clàr-tonn a th' ann am FDS air a lùbadh le modalair. 'S e 2A03 an t-seata buille/triantan/fuaim às a bheil a' mhòr-chuid de chiptune.

column1: Scramble which glyph means which brightness. Same set, different handwriting. Seeded, so it stays put.
column2: Measgaich dè an glyph a tha a' ciallachadh dè an soilleireachd. An aon seata, làmh-sgrìobhaidh eile. Le sìol, mar sin fuirichidh e.

column1: Pixel sort: runs of pixels sorted by brightness within a row, which is what makes datamosh look melted.
column2: Seòrsachadh piogsail: ruith de phiogsail air an seòrsachadh a rèir soilleireachd taobh a-staigh sreath, a nì datamosh coltach ri leaghadh.

column1: How many cells the marks may climb. They thin out as they go, so a tall reach trails rather than doubles.
column2: Co mheud ceallan as urrainn do na comharran dìreadh. Tanaichidh iad mar a thèid iad, mar sin slaodaidh ruigsinn àrd seach dùblachadh.

column1: cue act val  -  G take  S stop  F fade out (val = tenths of a second)  V volume  O opacity  J jump to row
column2: cue gnìomh luach  -  G gabh  S stad  F fad a-mach (luach = deicheamhan diog)  V àirde  O trìd-shoilleireachd  J leum gu sreath

column1: Harmonic weight: a pure chime at zero, brass at full. This is the difference between a ping and a fanfare.
column2: Cuideam co-sheirm: clag fìor aig neoni, umha aig làn. 'S e seo an diofar eadar ping is fanfare.

column1: Steps through the inputs this computer has. 'Settings input' follows the input chosen in Settings > Audio.
column2: Ceumaichidh e tro na h-inntrigidhean air a' choimpiutair seo. Leanaidh 'Settings input' an t-inntrigeadh a chaidh a thaghadh ann an Settings > Audio.

column1: Embers to roaring. It still surges and settles at any setting -- a fire that does not move reads as a photo
column2: Bho èibhlean gu buaireadh. Bidh e fhathast ag èirigh 's a' socrachadh aig ìre sam bith -- tha teine nach gluais coltach ri dealbh

column1: Reference pitch. 440 is modern standard, 432 the common alternative, and older instruments sat lower still.
column2: Àirde iomraidh. 'S e 440 an ìre ùr-nodha, 432 an roghainn eile chumanta, agus bha seann ionnstramaidean nas ìsle fhathast.

column1: Where the sting starts. Under a voice it wants to stay out of the way; over a room it wants to cut through.
column2: Far an tòisich an sting. Fo ghuth bu chòir dha fuireach a-mach às an rathad; thairis air seòmar bu chòir dha gearradh troimhe.

column1: Digital gain on the input, -40 to +40 dB. Set the interface's own preamp first; this is for the last few dB.
column2: Buannachd didseatach air an inntrigeadh, -40 gu +40 dB. Suidhich preamp an eadar-aghaidh an toiseach; tha seo airson an beagan dB mu dheireadh.

column1: Pulse the size. On its own this moves width AND height together; give height its own ~ to squash and stretch
column2: Buille air a' mheud. Leis fhèin gluaisidh seo leud IS àirde còmhla; thoir ~ fhèin don àirde gus brùthadh is sìneadh

column1: A card fills the frame; a Lower Third is a name and a role, low on a transparent frame, with an in and an out
column2: Lìonaidh cairt am frèam; 's e ainm is dreuchd a th' ann an Lower Third, ìosal air frèam trìd-shoilleir, le teachd a-steach is a-mach

column1: Held keeps the last displacement rather than removing it -- the picture stays bent the way the driver left it.
column2: Cumaidh Held an gluasad mu dheireadh seach a thoirt air falbh -- fanaidh an dealbh lùbte mar a dh'fhàg an draibhear e.

column1: 12.5 and 25 are thin and reedy, 50 is hollow. 75 sounds identical to 25 -- it is here because trackers expose it.
column2: Tha 12.5 is 25 caol is cuilceach, tha 50 falamh. Tha 75 dìreach mar 25 -- tha e an seo oir tha trackers ga shealltainn.

column1: Quantise the output like the hardware. The steps ARE the sound; smoothing them makes it a synth imitating a chip.
column2: Cuantaich an às-chur mar an uidheam. 'S iad na ceuman an fhuaim; nì an lìomhadh synth a tha ag atharrais air chip.

column1: Moves every selected cue's trim by the same dB, keeping the differences between them; typing a value sets them all to it
column2: Gluaisidh e trim gach cue taghte leis an aon dB, a' cumail an eadar-dhealachaidhean; suidhichidh luach sgrìobhte iad uile air

column1: Where the playlist's crosspoints send it (Settings > Audio). Click to open the matrix by name, starting from exactly that
column2: Far an cuir puingean-tarsainn na liosta-cluiche e (Settings > Audio). Briog gus am matrix fhosgladh air ainm, bhon dearbh shlighe sin

column1: name values with  d = ...;  end with one expression, or three for red green blue  |  Shift+Enter: new line  |  Enter: apply
column2: ainmich luachan le  d = ...;  crìochnaich le aon abairt, no trì airson dearg uaine gorm  |  Shift+Enter: loidhne ùr  |  Enter: cuir an sàs

column1: Put back what it started from once the ramp lands (after the stop): a deck left ready for its next cue, a swell that lets go
column2: Cuir air ais na bha aig an toiseach aon uair 's gun ruigeas an ramp (às dèidh an stad): deck deiseil airson an ath cue, at a leigeas às

column1: Which speech model makes the captions: English, any language, or the slower, more accurate pair. Each is a one-time download
column2: Dè am modail cainnte a nì na fo-thiotalan: Beurla, cànan sam bith, no am paidhir as slaodaiche ach nas mionaidiche. Thèid gach fear a luchdachadh sìos aon turas

column1: What the mask cuts: this cue wherever it plays, this playlist on the focused output, that output's whole picture, or its matte
column2: Na ghearras am masg: an cue seo ge b' e càite an cluich e, an liosta-cluiche seo air an às-chur le fòcas, dealbh slàn an às-chuir sin, no am matte aige

column1: Play at the screen's rate when it is within 0.2% (59.94 on 60): every frame shown once, the sound up to 3.5 cents sharp or flat
column2: Cluich aig reat na sgrìn nuair a tha e taobh a-staigh 0.2% (59.94 air 60): gach frèam aon turas, an fhuaim suas gu 3.5 sgillin geur no flat

column1: Quarter turns are exact and stay crisp. Spinning samples at an angle, which tears pixel art -- sometimes that is what you want.
column2: Tha cairteal-tionndaidh mionaideach is fuirichidh iad geur. Bheir snìomh sampall aig ceàrn, a reubas ealain piogsail -- uaireannan 's e sin a tha thu ag iarraidh.

column1: Every take starts the puppetry the same way, so a rehearsed look repeats instead of depending on how long the app has been open.
column2: Tòisichidh gach take an t-siubhal san aon dòigh, gus an tig coltas a chaidh ath-aithris air ais seach a bhith an urra ri cho fada 's a tha an aplacaid fosgailte.

column1: What aims each tilt: its own position, the picture's luma gradient so characters lean the way the image does, or the cell's hue.
column2: Na stiùireas gach claonadh: an àite aige fhèin, caisead luma an deilbh gus an aom na caractaran mar an ìomhaigh, no tuar na cealla.

column1: Name a channel or a pair once. Playlists send to the name, so a different interface means changing the names here, not every cue.
column2: Ainmich seanail no paidhir aon uair. Cuiridh liostaichean-cluiche chun an ainm, mar sin 's e atharrachadh nan ainmean an seo a th' ann an eadar-aghaidh eile, chan e gach cue.

column1: Click a crosspoint to walk it: off, 0, -3, -6, -12 dB. Drag it sideways for any level. A playlist with none plays to its own device.
column2: Briog air puing-tarsainn gus a cuairteachadh: dheth, 0, -3, -6, -12 dB. Slaod i gu taobh airson ìre sam bith. Cluichidh liosta gun gin dhiubh gu a h-inneal fhèin.

column1: Sprite sets installed in data/sprites. Each folder there is a set; cycling picks one and wraps back to none. Right-click turns them off.
column2: Seataichean sprite ann an data/sprites. 'S e seata a th' anns gach pasgan; taghaidh cuairteachadh fear agus tillidh e gu gun ghin. Cuiridh briog deas dheth iad.

column1: Internal resolution, 1 chunkiest to 5 finest. This is an aesthetic control as much as a speed one -- the 8-bit look comes from big pixels.
column2: Dùmhlachd a-staigh, 1 as gairbhe gu 5 as mìne. 'S e smachd coltais a th' ann cho mòr ri smachd luaiths -- thig coltas 8-bit bho phiogsail mhòra.

column1: Picture takes colour from the image. Green, amber and cyan are terminal phosphors. Palette locks the text to the selected hardware palette.
column2: Gabhaidh Picture dath bhon ìomhaigh. 'S e fosfairean teirmineal a th' ann an uaine, òmar is saidhean. Glasaidh Palette an teacsa ris a' phailead uidheim a chaidh a thaghadh.

column1: SUBTLE self-heals (H.264). CLASSIC is the real smear (MPEG-4). EXTREME is chunkier and smears constantly. Changing this re-prepares the cue.
column2: Leighisidh SUBTLE e fhèin (H.264). 'S e CLASSIC an fhìor smal (MPEG-4). Tha EXTREME nas gairbhe is smalaichidh e fad na h-ùine. Ullaichidh atharrachadh seo an cue a-rithist.

column1: Sine for line-up, pink to ring out a PA, white to find rattles, sweep to hear where a room rings, identify to walk the outputs one at a time.
column2: Sine airson co-thaobhadh, pinc gus PA a bhualadh, geal gus gliongartaich a lorg, sguabadh gus cluinntinn càite am bi seòmar a' seirm, identify gus coiseachd tro na às-chuir aon às dèidh aoin.

column1: Which effect, by its place in the stack of the cue that deck is playing when this fires. With nothing there, the fade says so and does nothing
column2: Dè a' bhuaidh, a rèir a h-àite ann an cruach a' cue a tha an deck sin a' cluich nuair a thèid seo. Gun dad ann, canaidh am fad sin is cha dèan e dad

column1: Each frame blended into the next. This is the Hypno signature -- at 0 it is a pattern generator, above it the picture starts feeding on itself.
column2: Gach frèam air a mheasgachadh dhan ath fhear. 'S e seo comharra Hypno -- aig 0 's e gineadair pàtrain a th' ann, os a chionn tòisichidh an dealbh ga bhiathadh fhèin.

column1: What is through the window on the hearth wall: a garden, rain, snow or the sea. A room with weather outside reads as somewhere rather than as a wall
column2: Na tha tron uinneig air balla an teallaich: gàrradh, uisge, sneachd no a' mhuir. Leughaidh seòmar le aimsir a-muigh mar àite seach balla

column1: BY FIXTURE: the lights in the patch (Settings > Network > FIXTURES), by name. CHANNELS: channel=level by hand. A cue can carry both; channels go last
column2: A RÈIR INNEAL: na solais sa phatch (Settings > Network > FIXTURES), air ainm. SEANAILEAN: seanail=ìre le làimh. Faodaidh cue an dà chuid a ghiùlan; thèid seanailean mu dheireadh

column1: Each character rocks as though it were a card being tilted. Every cell has its own phase, so the grid breathes instead of sliding about as one sheet.
column2: Luaisgidh gach caractar mar chairt ga aomadh. Tha a ceum fhèin aig gach cealla, mar sin bidh anail aig a' ghriod seach sleamhnadh mar aon duilleag.

column1: Pen: click for corners, drag for curves, click the first point to close (P). Points: drag, click the outline to add one, Alt-click or Delete to remove
column2: Peann: briog airson oiseanan, slaod airson lùban, briog air a' chiad phuing gus dùnadh (P). Puingean: slaod, briog air an iomall gus tè a chur ris, Alt-briog no Delete gus a toirt air falbh

column1: The chip's three channels. They differ in kind: triangle has no volume control on the hardware, and noise is a shift register rather than an oscillator.
column2: Trì seanailean a' chip. Tha iad eadar-dhealaichte: chan eil smachd àirde aig triantan air an uidheam, agus 's e clàr-gluasaid a th' ann am fuaim seach oscillator.

column1: Curated sets of symbols and emoji -- stars, notes, flowers, arrows, weather, runes, faces. Picking one fills the custom glyphs below, which stays editable.
column2: Seataichean taghte de shamhlaidhean is emoji -- rionnagan, nòtaichean, flùraichean, saighdean, aimsir, rùintean, aodainn. Lìonaidh taghadh fear na glyphs gnàthaichte gu h-ìosal, a ghabhas deasachadh fhathast.

column1: Play from the computer keyboard, Ableton layout: A W S E D F T G Y H U J, Z and X for octave. While this is ON those keys make notes instead of firing cues.
column2: Cluich bhon mheur-chlàr, cruth Ableton: A W S E D F T G Y H U J, Z is X airson ochdad. Fhad 's a tha seo AIR nì na h-iuchraichean sin nòtaichean seach cues a chur.

column1: Deck opacity, deck volume, the master dimmer, the active cue's own brightness / contrast / saturation / hue, or a knob of one of its effects or audio effects
column2: Trìd-shoilleireachd deck, àirde deck, am prìomh dimmer, soilleireachd / iomsgaradh / sàthachadh / tuar a' cue ghnìomhaich, no putan aon de na buaidhean no buaidhean fuaime aige

column1: Scanlines, phosphor bloom and RGB fringing. The bloom is the part that matters -- a phosphor spills sideways, which is why a CRT looks like it is emitting light.
column2: Loidhnichean-sganaidh, blàth fosfair is iomall RGB. 'S e am blàth am pàirt as cudromaiche -- dòirtidh fosfar gu taobh, agus sin as coireach gu bheil CRT coltach ri solas a chur a-mach.

column1: Torn scanline bands and RGB separation. In text mode it also corrupts CELLS -- whole rows lock to one repeating character, the way a real text screen loses sync.
column2: Bannan loidhne reubte is sgaradh RGB. Ann am modh teacsa millidh e CEALLAN cuideachd -- glasaidh sreathan slàna ri aon charactar ath-aithriseach, mar fhìor sgrìn teacsa a' call sioncronachaidh.

column1: Still holds the frame you are on. Flipbook plays the frames in turn. Replay draws the first frame stroke by stroke, the way it was drawn, then holds and starts again
column2: Cumaidh Still am frèam far a bheil thu. Cluichidh Flipbook na frèaman mu seach. Tarraingidh Replay a' chiad fhrèam stràc air stràc, mar a chaidh a tharraing, an uairsin cumaidh is tòisichidh e a-rithist

column1: Start, Stop, Pause, Resume, Load (stand it by without firing), Arm, Disarm, or Devamp it (a loop plays out its pass and ends); or Stop all, Pause all, Resume all: every deck
column2: Start, Stop, Pause, Resume, Load (cuir na sheasamh gun a chur), Arm, Disarm, no Devamp (cluichidh lùb an turas aice is crìochnaichidh i); no Stop all, Pause all, Resume all: gach deck

column1: Scope shows shape and clipping. Lissajous shows phase and polarity between the first two channels -- a diagonal the wrong way means one is inverted. Spectrum is third-octave bars.
column2: Seallaidh Scope cumadh is gearradh. Seallaidh Lissajous ceum is pòlaireachd eadar a' chiad dà sheanail -- tha trastan air an dòigh cheàrr a' ciallachadh gu bheil fear tionndaidhte. 'S e bàraichean trian-ochdan a th' ann an Spectrum.

column1: 0 picks the glyph the brightness asks for, 1 picks any glyph in the set. Turn it up to see the whole alphabet: ranked strictly by ink, a flat area picks one mark and the rest never appear.
column2: Taghaidh 0 an glyph a tha an soilleireachd ag iarraidh, taghaidh 1 glyph sam bith san t-seata. Tionndaidh suas e gus an aibidil slàn fhaicinn: rangaichte a rèir inc, taghaidh raon còmhnard aon chomharra is cha nochd an còrr idir.

column1: Blocks and dithers read as density; the ASCII ramp reads as text; symbols read as wreckage. Cycling this clears a custom glyph string, since that would override it -- the preset row puts one back.
column2: Leughaidh blocaichean is dithers mar dhùmhlachd; leughaidh an ramp ASCII mar theacsa; leughaidh samhlaidhean mar sprùilleach. Glanaidh cuairteachadh seo sreang glyph gnàthaichte, oir chuireadh i às dha -- cuiridh an sreath ro-shuidhichte fear air ais.

column1: Equal temperament buys free modulation at the cost of every interval being slightly wrong. Just and pythagorean are exactly in tune in one key. Bohlen-Pierce divides a twelfth, so it has no octaves.
column2: Ceannaichidh gleusadh co-ionann atharrachadh-iuchrach saor aig cosgais gu bheil gach eadar-ama beagan ceàrr. Tha gleusadh dìreach is pythagorean gu tur ann an gleus ann an aon iuchair. Roinnidh Bohlen-Pierce an dàrna deug, mar sin chan eil ochdadan aige.

column2: Deuchainn: gluais e air an uidheam-smachd

column2: Suidhich ID goirid cue airson lorg/goto

column2: Suidhich targaid goto airson cues taghte

column2: ORDER - thèid cues sìos an liosta

column2: tionndaidhidh doimhneachd 1 e fad na slighe

column1: The intro video is on the office computer. Select it and delete it, or RELINK it if you have the file.

column2: Pacaich e mar bhogsa gruag-shìnte. A h-uile rud a-staigh, gun dad sgaoilte.

column1: Checked, fixed, bundled. On the other computer, open the show in the bundle and everything is there.
