column1: My favourite source: oscillators, mirrors and feedback. A halftime show with no camera at all.
column2: An tùs as fheàrr leam: oscillators, sgàthanan agus fios-air-ais. Taisbeanadh leth-ùine gun aon chamara.

column1: Halftime! Somebody get me some lights. And a band. And a sandwich.
column2: Leth-ùine! Thoiribh solais dhomh. Agus còmhlan. Agus ceapaire.

column1: Select the synth and TAKE it. Then look at the monitor: your ink is still up.
column2: Tagh an synth agus brùth TAKE. An uair sin coimhead air a' monitor: tha an inc fhathast ann.

column1: Playlist 2 did not change, so its ink stays over whatever playlist 1 shows. Each playlist changes on its own.
column2: Cha do dh'atharraich liosta-cluiche 2. Fanaidh an inc aice os cionn rud sam bith a sheallas liosta-cluiche 1. Atharraichidh gach liosta leatha fhèin.

column1: Leave the circle up. It's a good circle. It goes with everything.
column2: Fàg an cearcall ann. Cearcall math. Thèid e leis a h-uile rud.

column1: A test pattern, a replay, ink on a layer, a still, and halftime. That's the booth.
column2: Pàtran-deuchainn, ath-chluich, inc air filleadh, dealbh agus leth-ùine. Sin am bogsa-aithris.

column1: Replay in the Draw section draws your lines back the way you drew them. He will love that.
column2: Tarraingidh Replay san earrann Draw na loidhnichean agad a-rithist mar a rinn thu iad. Còrdaidh sin ris.

column1: Same time next week. Bring a bigger pen.
column2: An aon àm an-ath-sheachdain. Thoir peann nas motha leat.

column1: Now THAT is a busy play. I can't see the field. I love it.
column2: SEO gluasad trang. Chan fhaic mi an raon. Tha gaol agam air.

column1: Two projectors overlap, and each fades its edge so the overlap is not twice as bright. Watch the sides of the monitor go soft.
column2: Tha dà phroiseactair a' dol thairis air a chèile. Lùghdaichidh gach fear a oir fhèin gus nach bi an t-àite còmhla dà uair cho soilleir. Coimhead air taobhan a' monitor a' fàs bog.

column1: A game show, skapi. Three contestants, one buzzer, and a host who is not here tonight. Press START.
column2: Taisbeanadh-ceiste, skapi. Trì farpaisich, aon chlag, agus fear-an-taighe nach eil an seo a-nochd. Brùth TÒISICH.

column1: Cue numbers, hotkeys, and GO from other machines.
column2: Àireamhan cue, iuchraichean-luatha, agus GO bho innealan eile.

column1: Forty years I turned the letters. Tonight they gave me the microphone. Nobody panic.
column2: Dà fhichead bliadhna a' tionndadh nan litrichean. A-nochd thug iad am micreofon dhomh. Na gabhaibh clisgeadh.

column1: Theatre numbers its cues: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Deckboy reads them all.
column2: Tha àireamhan air cue san taigh-cluiche: Q3, Q3.5, Q12A. Leughaidh Deckboy iad uile.

column1: Numbers! I know letters. Numbers are letters that went to college.
column2: Àireamhan! 'S aithne dhomh litrichean. 'S e litrichean le ceum oilthighe a th' ann an àireamhan.

column1: GOTO crosses a long list faster than scrolling. Much faster.
column2: Thèid GOTO tro liosta fhada nas luaithe na sgroladh. Fada nas luaithe.

column1: F1 to F10, F12, or the number pad. Each one is a buzzer.
column2: F1 gu F10, F12, no am meur-chlàr àireamhach. 'S e clag a th' anns gach iuchair.

column1: Every contestant gets a buzzer. I get the letters. It's fine. It's fine.
column2: Gheibh gach farpaiseach clag. Gheibh mise na litrichean. Tha sin ceart gu leòr. Ceart gu leòr.

column1: No mouse, no list, no looking. Only the key.
column2: Gun luchag, gun liosta, gun sùil. Dìreach an iuchair.

column1: Buzz! A winner! I've never said that. I've only pointed at it.
column2: Ding! Buannaiche! Cha tuirt mi sin riamh. Cha do rinn mi ach comharrachadh air.

column1: And for our viewers at home: yes, you can push the buttons too.
column2: Agus dhan luchd-amhairc aig an taigh: seadh, faodaidh sibhse na putanan a bhrùthadh cuideachd.

column1: Numbers, GOTO, a buzzer, and GO from anywhere. You could host a game show now.
column2: Àireamhan, GOTO, clag agus GO à àite sam bith. Dh'fhaodadh tu taisbeanadh-ceiste a stiùireadh a-nis.

column1: Goodnight, everybody! Tomorrow I go back to the letters. I'll miss you.
column2: Oidhche mhath dhuibh uile! Tillidh mi dha na litrichean a-màireach. Bidh mi gad ionndrainn.

column1: And the number is... not three. I'll allow it. I turn anything.
column2: Agus 's e an àireamh... chan e trì. Gabhaidh mi ris. Tionndaidhidh mi rud sam bith.

column1: A second playlist is a layer over the map. The lizard stays underneath. For now.
column2: 'S e filleadh os cionn a' mhapa a th' ann an dàrna liosta-cluiche. Fanaidh an dearc-luachrach fodha. An-dràsta co-dhiù.

column1: A Lower Third, a name, a title card, a backdrop. The lizard has left the studio.
column2: Lower Third, ainm, cairt-tiotal agus cùl-raon. Tha an dearc-luachrach air an stiùidio fhàgail.

column1: That's not my name. It's a lovely name. Now, about that lizard...
column2: Chan e sin m' ainm. Ainm àlainn. Nise, mun dearc-luachrach sin...

column1: A rocket built in a basement, skapi, an inventor who wants cheese, and a dog who does the real work. Press START.
column2: Rocaid a chaidh a thogail ann an seilear, skapi, innleadair ag iarraidh càise, agus cù a nì an obair. Brùth TÒISICH.

column1: Stage timers: a countdown over a picture, a hold, and a view for the person on stage.
column2: Uaireadairean àrd-ùrlair: cunntadh sìos air dealbh, stad agus sealladh dhan neach air an àrd-ùrlar.

column1: Playlist 2 is selected, over the rocket. SOURCE, then Stage Timer.
column2: Tha liosta-cluiche 2 taghte, os cionn na rocaid. TÙS, an uair sin Stage Timer.

column1: *checks his watch, then the rocket, then his watch*
column2: *coimheadaidh e air an uaireadair, air an rocaid, agus air an uaireadair a-rithist*

column1: Select the timer and TAKE it. I have cleared its backdrop, so the rocket shows behind the numbers.
column2: Tagh an t-uaireadair agus brùth TAKE. Thug mi an cùl-raon aige air falbh, agus chì thu an rocaid air cùl nan àireamhan.

column1: Past zero it keeps going and counts the overtime. Very honest. Slightly rude.
column2: An dèidh neoni cumaidh e air agus cunntaidh e an ùine a bharrachd. Glè onarach. Beagan mì-mhodhail.

column1: Close MENU, click the Deck 1 tab, then select 'The rocket (lift-off)' and TAKE it.
column2: Dùin CLÀR, briog air taba Deck 1, tagh 'The rocket (lift-off)' agus brùth TAKE.

column1: The clock is on playlist 2, so it stays up while the rocket changes underneath it.
column2: Tha an t-uaireadair air liosta-cluiche 2. Fanaidh e suas fhad 's a dh'atharraicheas an rocaid fodha.

column1: We have lift-off, Grommet! ...Grommet? Who's flying it?
column2: Tha sinn air falbh, Grommet! ...Grommet? Cò tha ga stiùireadh?

column1: A countdown, a hold, a pilot's view and a launch. Bring crackers.
column2: Cunntadh sìos, stad, sealladh a' phìleit agus cur air bhog. Thoir briosgaidean leat.

column1: A magic show, skapi. A trunk, a rubber chicken, and one beat where everything changes at once. Press START.
column2: Taisbeanadh draoidheachd, skapi. Ciste, cearc rubair agus aon bhuille far an atharraich a h-uile rud còmhla. Brùth TÒISICH.

column1: Two playlists are two layers, and TAKE ALL changes both together. Tonight you will see why that matters.
column2: 'S e dà fhilleadh a th' ann an dà liosta-cluiche. Atharraichidh TAKE ALL an dà chuid còmhla. Chì thu a-nochd carson a tha sin cudromach.

column1: The chicken goes on its own layer. Press the + at the end of the playlist tabs.
column2: Thèid a' chearc air a filleadh fhèin. Brùth + aig deireadh thabaichean nan liostaichean-cluiche.

column1: The lit tab is the playlist that gets the next cue. Its chip now says 'to Out 1': it is layered over playlist 1 on that output.
column2: 'S i an taba shoilleir an liosta-cluiche a gheibh an ath cue. Tha 'gu A-mach 1' air a' chomharra a-nis: tha i os cionn liosta-cluiche 1 air an às-chur sin.

column1: Turnip Top has put the chicken in playlist 2. In playlist 1, TAKE 'The trunk (open)'. Then in playlist 2, TAKE the chicken.
column2: Chuir Turnip Top a' chearc ann an liosta-cluiche 2. Ann an liosta-cluiche 1, cuir 'The trunk (open)' air le TAKE. An uair sin ann an liosta-cluiche 2, cuir a' chearc air le TAKE.

column1: The chicken is clear all round, so it covers only itself. Watch the monitor between the two TAKEs.
column2: Tha a h-uile rud timcheall na circe trìd-shoilleir. Cha chòmhdaich i ach a h-àite fhèin. Coimhead air a' monitor eadar an dà TAKE.

column1: Did you see it? For a moment the trunk was open and empty: two TAKEs are two moments. The trick is reset. Now select the open trunk in playlist 1 and the chicken in playlist 2, then TAKE ALL.
column2: Am faca tu? Bha a' chiste fosgailte agus falamh car tiota: dà TAKE, dà mhionaid eadar-dhealaichte. Tha an cleas air ais aig an toiseach. Tagh a' chiste fhosgailte ann an liosta-cluiche 1 agus a' chearc ann an liosta-cluiche 2, agus brùth TAKE ALL.

column1: TAKE ALL takes every playlist's selected cue on one beat. No gap, no empty trunk.
column2: Cuiridh TAKE ALL an cue taghte aig gach liosta-cluiche air aig an aon bhuille. Gun bheàrn, gun chiste fhalamh.

column1: The chicken was late. They saw an empty trunk. In magic we call that a trunk.
column2: Bha a' chearc fadalach. Chunnaic iad ciste fhalamh. Ann an draoidheachd canaidh sinn ciste ri sin.

column1: Trick two. Drag playlist 2's opacity fader down to nothing. The chicken fades away.
column2: An dàrna cleas. Slaod fader neo-thrìd-shoilleireachd liosta-cluiche 2 sìos gu neoni. Thèid a' chearc à sealladh.

column1: Every playlist has its own opacity. Down is a fade out, with no cue at all.
column2: Tha a neo-thrìd-shoilleireachd fhèin aig gach liosta-cluiche. Sìos, agus seargaidh an dealbh às gun cue sam bith.

column1: Ta-daaa! ...Hold for applause. Hold. Now watch it go.
column2: Ta-daaa! ...Fuirich ris a' bhualadh-bhas. Fuirich. Nise coimhead oirre a' falbh.

column1: Trick three. Bring it back: playlist 2's opacity all the way up.
column2: An treas cleas. Thoir air ais i: neo-thrìd-shoilleireachd liosta-cluiche 2 fad na slighe suas.

column1: Where did it go? Back in the trunk. Everything goes back in the trunk.
column2: Càit an deach i? Air ais dhan chiste. Thèid a h-uile rud air ais dhan chiste.

column1: An appearance done wrong, then right, a vanish and a return. Nazdrave.
column2: Nochdadh ceàrr, an uair sin ceart, dol à sealladh agus tilleadh. Nazdrave.

column1: A playlist can also sit on any output. Two layers, a great many tricks.
column2: Faodaidh liosta-cluiche a bhith air às-chur sam bith cuideachd. Dà fhilleadh, iomadh cleas.

column1: It's back! Thank you! I'm here all week! The chicken is here forever.
column2: Tha i air ais! Tapadh leibh! Tha mise an seo fad na seachdain! Tha a' chearc an seo gu bràth.

column1: A cooking show, skapi. Live. The kitchen is on fire. Press START.
column2: Taisbeanadh còcaireachd, skapi. Beò. Tha an cidsin na theine. Brùth TÒISICH.
Ta-da! Fhathast a' còcaireachd! ...Fhathast a' losgadh.

column1: Bork! De fire extinguisher is also on fire!
column2: Bork! Tha an t-inneal-smàlaidh na theine cuideachd, sgiùrdi-bùrk!

column1: BLACK to hide, PANIC to stop, TAKE to come back. You will survive any kitchen.
column2: dubh gus falach, PANIC gus stad, TAKE gus tilleadh. Thig thu beò à cidsin sam bith.

column1: A fashion show, skapi. One designer, one runway, and a look she will want back. Press START.
column2: Taisbeanadh fasan, skapi. Aon dealbhaiche, aon àrd-ùrlar agus coltas a bhios i ag iarraidh air ais. Brùth TÒISICH.

column1: A preset stores a whole look and brings it back with one button.
column2: Sàbhailidh ro-shuidheachadh coltas slàn agus bheir e air ais e le aon phutan.

column1: Darling. A look is not a look until you can get it back.
column2: A ghràidh. Chan e coltas a th' ann mura faigh thu air ais e.

column1: Buttons. Good. I design with buttons.
column2: Putanan. Math. Bidh mise a' dealbhadh le putanan.

column1: Store it. Before somebody has ideas.
column2: Sàbhail e. Mus tig beachdan gu duine.

column1: Close the DASH (Esc), then select Look two and TAKE it.
column2: Dùin DASH (Esc), tagh Look two agus brùth TAKE.

column1: A cape. On my runway. Someone will trip, darling. Someone always trips.
column2: Clòca. Air m' àrd-ùrlar-sa. Tuislichidh cuideigin, a ghràidh. Tuislichidh cuideigin an-còmhnaidh.

column1: Recall: the whole look comes back at once.
column2: Ath-ghairm: tillidh an coltas slàn aig an aon àm.

column1: Thank you. We will never speak of the cape again.
column2: Tapadh leat. Cha bhruidhinn sinn air a' chlòca a-rithist.

column1: Simple. Timeless. Recallable. Now go, darling. I have a fitting.
column2: Sìmplidh. Gun aois. Gabhaidh fhaighinn air ais. Falbh a-nis, a ghràidh. Tha aodach ri fheuchainn agam.

column1: Pushes, wipes, iris, dip to white, and more. I wrote half of them. On a Tuesday.
column2: Brùthaidhean, sguaban, iris, dol tro gheal agus eile. Sgrìobh mi leth dhiubh. Air Dimàirt.
A luchd-stiùiridh... cuiribh an gluasad air.

column1: A style, a time, and two very dramatic entrances. Roll credits.
column2: Stoidhle, ùine agus dà inntrigeadh glè dhràmadach. Na creideasan, mas e do thoil e.

column1: That is not an iris. ...It is better. I will allow it.
column2: Chan e iris a tha sin. ...Tha e nas fheàrr. Leigidh mi leis.

column1: An effect, a bend and the patch. The robots approve, I think. Their faces are helmets.
column2: Buaidh, lùbadh agus am patch. Tha na robotairean toilichte, tha mi an dùil. 'S e clogaidean an aghaidhean.

column1: Waveform, vectorscope, false colour. The scopes settled it. The agents did not.
column2: Cruth-tonn, vectorscope, dath-brèige. Rinn na meatairean co-dhùnadh. Cha do rinn na h-àidseantan.

column1: Major Tomasina is in orbit, skapi, and her picture has to reach the ground. Press START.
column2: Tha Major Tomasina ann an reul-chuairt, skapi, agus feumaidh an dealbh aice an talamh a ruigsinn. Brùth TÒISICH.

column1: Pictures leave by cable or network: NDI, SDI from a DeckLink card, ST 2110 for broadcast plants.
column2: Falbhaidh dealbhan tro chàball no lìonra: NDI, SDI bho chairt DeckLink, ST 2110 airson ionadan craolaidh.

column1: Ground control, this is Major Tomasina. Can you see my picture?
column2: Smachd air an talamh, seo Major Tomasina. Am faic sibh an dealbh agam?

column1: Every way down, on one page. Good. Space has very few cables.
column2: A h-uile slighe sìos air aon duilleag. Math. Chan eil mòran chàball san fhànais.

column1: Sending now. If nobody answers, I'll just float here.
column2: A' cur a-nis. Mura freagair duine, fanaidh mi a' fleòdradh an seo.

column1: Ground control, signing off. Tell my mother I waved.
column2: Smachd air an talamh, tha mi a' fàgail. Innsibh dha mo mhàthair gun do smèid mi.

column1: Ground control can see me! I can see my house from here.
column2: Chì smachd air an talamh mi! Chì mi an taigh agam às an seo.

column1: And one more window, showing the clock. Operators who watch a clock are never late.
column2: Agus aon uinneag eile leis an uaireadair. Cha bhi luchd-stiùiridh a choimheadas air uaireadair fadalach.

column1: The big window is window one, which is usually the programme.
column2: 'S i an uinneag mhòr uinneag a h-aon. Mar as trice 's e am prògram a tha innte.

column1: Windows, the ... menu, NEXT, the clock, a layout, tally. Mystery solved.
column2: Uinneagan, an clàr ..., NEXT, an t-uaireadair, cruth agus tally. Dìomhaireachd air fhuasgladh.

column2: FX CHOICE: feumaidh an roghainn a bhith A no B

column1: FX CHOICE: no effect at that index
column2: FX CHOICE: chan eil èifeachd sam bith aig a' chlàr-amais sin

column2: FX LFO: 's e A-D an slot airson na paramadairean, E airson an uiread, F agus G airson a' chòigeamh is an siathamh (no 0-6)

column1: Characters across. Fewer means bigger cells and less of the picture surviving, which is usually the point.

column2: Fuaim-chnap mhìn mothaiche aig a’ bhonn, gràn film garbh aig a’ mhullach.

column1: From an even blur to a streak along the angle, like movement.
column2: Bho dhoilleireachd chothromach gu srian an cois a’ cheàirn, mar ghluasad.

column1: How big the shards are. Small is frosted glass, large is a dropped plate.

column1: How far it smears: up to a few percent of the picture.
column2: Dè cho fad ’s a smàlas e: gu beagan cheudadan den dealbh.

column1: How fast the light walks around it. Zero holds it still.
column2: Dè cho luath ’s a choisicheas an solas mun cuairt. Cumaidh neoni na stad e.

column1: How much of the push goes downward rather than sideways.
column2: Dè an roinn den phutadh a thèid sìos seach gu taobh.

column1: How gently the change fades out at the edges of the band.
column2: Dè cho bog ’s a sheargas an t-atharrachadh aig oirean a’ bhanna.

column1: How wide a band of colours either side of it changes too.
column2: Leud a’ bhanna dathan gach taobh a dh’atharraicheas cuideachd.

column1: How fast the drips run. At the left the picture only sags.
column2: Dè cho luath ’s a ruitheas na boinneagan. Air a’ chlì cha dèan an dealbh ach cromadh.

column1: Line pitch in pixels, so this reads at 4K as well as at 720.
column2: Eadar-àm loidhne ann am piogsail, airson leughadh aig 4K cho math ri 720.

column1: How far back each skip jumps, from a stutter to half a second.
column2: Dè cho fada air ais a leumas gach leum, bho stamag gu leth-diog.

column1: How far the two eyes disagree. Brightness is read as nearness.
column2: Dè cho mòr ’s a tha an dà shùil eadar-dhealaichte. Leughar soilleireachd mar fhaisgeachd.

column1: How fast it closes. Slow enough not to chop the ends off words.
column2: Dè cho luath ’s a dhùineas e. Slaodach gu leòr gun cinn nam faclan a ghearradh.

column1: How many times a skip repeats before the sound catches up again.
column2: Cia mheud uair a thilleas leum mus glac an fhuaim suas a-rithist.

column1: How dark the dark lines go. All the way up is black between lines.
column2: Dè cho dorcha ’s a thèid na loidhnichean dorcha. Aig a’ bhàrr tha dubh eadar loidhnichean.

column1: How fast the open slit crosses the picture. Slow smears a long moment across the frame.
column2: Luaths an sgoltaidh fhosgailte tarsainn an deilbh. Slaodach smàlaidh mionaid fhada thar an fhrèam.

column1: How fast the wave travels. Faster spreads further in the same time and interferes more.
column2: Luaths na tuinne. Nas luaithe sgaoilidh nas fhaide san aon ùine is bidh barrachd eadar-theachd ann.

column1: How fine the water is. Long ocean swell at one end, rain on a puddle at the other.
column2: Mìnead an uisge. Sèid fhada chuain aig aon cheann, uisge air lòn aig a’ cheann eile.

column1: How irregular the growth is. Low gives an even honeycomb, high gives long shards.
column2: Neo-riaghailteachd an fhàis. Ìosal nì cìr-mheala chothromach, àrd nì spealgan fada.

column1: How long the reaction runs each frame. Short is a stain, long is an organism.
column2: Fad an fhreagairt gach frèam. Goirid na smal, fada na fhàs-bheairt.

column1: How much of the picture shows behind the lines. None at the left: lines on black.
column2: Dè an roinn den dealbh a chithear air cùl nan loidhnichean. Gin air a’ chlì: loidhnichean air dubh.

column1: How much of the picture glows: only the brightest at the left, nearly everything at the right.
column2: Dè an roinn den dealbh a dheàrrsas: dìreach an rud as soilleire air a’ chlì, cha mhòr a h-uile càil air an làimh dheis.

column1: How many places drip: a few big drips at the left, many thin ones at the right.
column2: Cia mheud àite a shileas: beagan boinneagan mòra air a’ chlì, mòran caola air an làimh dheis.

column1: 0 flows ALONG the edges, so colour orbits the shapes. 1 flows across them, which bleeds the picture into itself.
column2: Sruthaidh 0 RI OIREAN, mun cuairt nan cumaidhean. Sruthaidh 1 tarsainn orra, a’ sgaoileadh na deilbh innte fhèin.

column2: ASCII WOBBLEMODE: drift | flow (a’ leantainn soilleireachd) | hue (a’ leantainn dath); gun argamaid, cuairtich

column2: Gluasad gorm an taobh siubhail is dearg aig an oir. Aig neoni cumaidh e an dath, mar lionsa.

column1: Bright: bright things drip over the dark, as text and logos do. Whole picture: everything is wax, and the picture itself runs down in its own colours.
column2: Soilleir: sileadh nithean soilleir thar dorchadas, mar theacsa is suaicheantasan. An dealbh gu lèir: tha a h-uile rud na chèir is a’ sileadh na dhathan fhèin.

column2: FADE TO: astar bho 0.25 gu 4 (0.5 leth-astar, ochdamh sìos)

column1: Flip across, upside down or both, or fold one half onto the other: right onto left, left onto right, bottom onto top, top onto bottom, or one corner into all four.
column2: Tionndaidh tarsainn, bun-os-cionn no an dà chuid; no paisg deas air clì, clì air deas, bonn air bàrr, bàrr air bonn, no aon oisean sna ceithir

column1: forget my defaults? only NEW changes, this show keeps its settings: press again
column2: Dìochuimhnich mo bhun-roghainnean? Chan atharraich ach NEW; cumaidh an taisbeanadh seo a roghainnean: brùth a-rithist

column1: full-frame and no picture - bends when the picture shrinks
column2: làn-fhrèam is gun dealbh — lùbaidh nuair a chrìonas an dealbh

column1: How bright a pixel has to be before it lifts at all, so only the highlights spike.
column2: Cho soilleir ’s a dh’fheumas piogsail a bhith mus èirich e; dìreach na solasan àrda

column1: How bright a pixel has to be to join a run. Lower catches more of the picture and the runs grow longer.
column2: Soilleireachd gus ruith a dhèanamh. Nas ìsle, glacar barrachd dhen dealbh is fàsaidh na ruith nas fhaide

column1: How deep the picture is treated as being. The brightness becomes height and is lit from the side.
column2: Doimhneachd na deilbh. Bidh soilleireachd na h-àirde le solas bhon taobh

column1: How faint a gradient still registers. High turns the quietest shading into visible structure.
column2: Mothalachd do chaiseadan fann. Nochdaidh luach àrd structar san dubhar as laige

column1: How far away. Distance dulls the top and softens the difference between the ears.
column2: Astar. Lùghdaichidh astar na triceadan àrda is an diofar eadar na cluasan

column1: How far back the chain listens. The picture is played through a delay, so this is the distance the damage is dragged across.
column2: Dè cho fada air ais a dh’èisteas an t-slabhraidh. Thèid an dealbh tro dhàil; seo an t-astar thar an tèid am milleadh a shlaodadh

column1: How far the burn spreads off the edge, and how hot its colour runs.
column2: Dè cho fada a sgaoileas an losgadh bhon oir is cho teth ’s a bhios a dhath

column1: How far the colour turns on each trip round the loop. This is the oil-slick: the trail walks through the spectrum instead of fading.
column2: Tionndadh datha gach cuairt. Mar fhilm ola: thèid an lorg tron speactram an àite seargadh

column1: How far the picture stands out. Bright parts come forward, dark parts stay back. At the left it is flat.
column2: Dè cho fada a sheasas an dealbh a-mach. Soilleir air adhart, dorcha air ais. Rèidh aig a’ chlì

column1: How far the picture swings the filter. The cue's own brightness opens and closes it, so a cut to black takes the top off the sound.
column2: Buaidh na deilbh air a’ chriathrag. Fosglaidh is dùinidh soilleireachd na gairm i; gearradh gu dubh a’ toirt nan triceadan àrda às

column1: How far the top comes down as the end approaches. This is not a fade: the level is left alone.
column2: Dè cho mòr a thuiteas na triceadan àrda faisg air a’ cheann. Cha searg an ìre fuaime

column1: How fast it settles away while held. At zero it holds indefinitely, which is what room tone under a held title wants.
column2: Cho luath ’s a sheargas e fhad ’s a tha e ga chumail. Aig neoni mairidh e gun chrìoch, airson fuaim seòmair fo thiotal ga chumail

column1: How fast what has dripped hardens away. At the left the drips stay until the cue changes.
column2: Cho luath ’s a chruadhaicheas na boinneagan às. Aig a’ chlì mairidh iad gus an atharraich a’ ghairm

column1: How hard it holds once it is working. Gentle at the bottom, a limiter at the top.
column2: Cho teann ’s a chumas e nuair a bhios e ag obair. Socair aig a’ bhonn, cuingealaiche aig a’ bhàrr

column1: How hard the light gathers where the rays converge. This is the part that makes it read as water rather than as a wobble.
column2: Dè cho làidir a chruinnicheas solas far an coinnich na gathan. Seo coltas uisge seach luasgadh

column1: How hard the moving parts throw sand. More shake clears the plate faster and makes the lines thinner.
column2: Neart tilgeil gainmhich nam pàirtean gluasadach. Glanaidh barrachd crathaidh a’ phlàta nas luaithe is nì e loidhnichean nas taine

column1: How long a grain is, in VIDEO FRAMES. On a 23.976 clip one frame is 41.7ms, which is not a musical value and is exactly the point.
column2: Faid gràinne ann am FRÈAMAICHEAN BHIDIO. Aig 23.976 tha frèam 41.7ms; chan e luach ciùil a th’ ann, a dh’aona ghnothach

column1: How long before the end it starts. The cue has to have a known length -- an open-ended one has no end to resolve into.
column2: Dè cho fada ron cheann a thòisicheas e. Feumar faid aithnichte; chan eil ceann aig gairm gun chrìoch airson socrachadh ann

column1: How long it is allowed to run. More steps means the ripples have crossed and reflected more times.
column2: Dè cho fada a ruitheas e. Le barrachd cheumannan bidh na tonnan air dol tarsainn is air ais barrachd thursan

column1: How long the old waves linger when the note changes. Left: they die at once. Right: they slosh for a while.
column2: Dè cho fada a mhaireas seann tonnan nuair a dh’atharraicheas an nota. Aig a’ chlì bàsaichidh iad sa bhad; aig an deas mairidh iad greis

column1: How much each facet catches the light, which is what makes them read as faceted rather than as flat blobs.
column2: Na ghlacas gach aghaidh de sholas, a’ toirt coltas aghaidhean seach cnapan rèidh

column1: How much its SIZE becomes distance. Shrink the picture and the sound goes away from you: the top comes off, the image narrows, the level drops.
column2: Buaidh MEUD air astar. Crìon an dealbh is falbhaidh am fuaim bhuat: nas lugha tricead àrd, ìomhaigh nas cumhainge is ìre nas ìsle

column1: How much of the bent picture goes round again. High is where it stops being an echo and starts eating itself.
column2: Na thilleas den dealbh lùbte dhan chuairt. Aig luach àrd tòisichidh am mac-talla ga ithe fhèin

column1: How much of the driver's movement the picture KEEPS. At zero it follows the driver frame by frame, which is a twitch. Wind it up and the motion accumulates, so the driver sculpts the picture over time and it holds the pose -- which is what puppetry means.
column2: Na GHLÈIDHEAS an dealbh de ghluasad an draibheir. Aig neoni leanaidh i frèam air fhrèam le priobadh. Àrdaich is cruinnichidh gluasad: cumaidh an draibhear an dealbh thar ùine is gleidhidh i a seasamh, mar phupaid

column1: How much of the picture's position on the output is used. A PIP on the left sounds on the left -- and it is a placement, not a pan: the far ear gets the delay and the head shadow too.
column2: Buaidh suidheachadh na deilbh air an às-chur. Cluinnear PIP clì air an taobh chlì; suidheachadh le dàil is sgàil a’ chinn don chluais as fhaide

column1: How much of the tail is kept going while the cue is held. Long enough to hide the splice in room tone, short enough not to smear a rhythm in it.
column2: Na mhaireas den earball fhad ’s a chumar a’ ghairm. Fada gu leòr gus alt fuaim seòmair fhalach, goirid gu leòr gun ruitheam a sgaoileadh

column1: How much room comes up under it, so the sound settles into the cut instead of being severed.
column2: Na chuirear de dh’fhuaim seòmair fodha gus an socraich am fuaim sa ghearradh seach briseadh

column1: How much the echo is distorted each pass. It compounds, so a little ripples and a lot melts the picture into itself.
column2: Milleadh a’ mhac-talla gach turas. Cruinnichidh e: beagan a’ dèanamh chrith-thonnan, mòran a’ leaghadh na deilbh innte fhèin

column1: How much the material draws in towards each drip, so it runs as a thin neck with a heavier head.
column2: Na tharraingeas an stuth a-steach gu gach boinneag, le amhaich thana is ceann nas truime

column1: How often its settings are corrupted. Corrupted far enough it oscillates on its own -- loud, but it cannot run away.
column2: Cho tric ’s a mhillear na roghainnean. Ma mhillear gu leòr, crithidh e leis fhèin — àrd ach fo smachd

column1: How quickly the picture springs back to rest once the driver stops pushing it. Only does anything when memory is up.
column2: Cho luath ’s a thilleas an dealbh gu fois nuair a stadas an draibhear. Chan obraich ach le cuimhne àrdaichte

column1: How quickly the room eats the top end. More damping is a softer, more furnished space.
column2: Cho luath ’s a shluigeas an seòmar na triceadan àrda. Barrachd mùchaidh, rùm nas buige le barrachd àirneis

column1: How readily an edge catches. Low sets the whole picture alight, high only the hardest lines.
column2: Cho furasta ’s a lasas oir. Ìosal, lasaidh an dealbh gu lèir; àrd, dìreach na loidhnichean as gèire

column1: How small a cut sets it off. With no picture it runs on a timer instead, and this is how often.
column2: Dè cho beag ’s a dh’fhaodas gearradh a bhith gus a phiobrachadh. Gun dealbh, ruithidh e air tìmear; seo cho tric

column1: How strongly the finished picture pushes the bend. Pair it with a picture effect whose LFO is set to Audio and the two drive each other.
column2: Neart buaidh na deilbh deise air an lùbadh. Paidhir ri buaidh deilbh le LFO air Audio is stiùiridh iad a chèile

column1: How wide a view is being compressed. Narrow is a punch down the middle, wide folds the whole frame into the centre.
column2: Leud an t-seallaidh ga dhlùthadh. Cumhang: buille sa mheadhan. Leathann: paisg am frèam gu lèir dhan mheadhan

column1: INPUTMONITOR: a row count, OPEN, CLOSE, CLEAR, PAUSE or RESUME
column2: INPUTMONITOR: àireamh shreathan, OPEN, CLOSE, CLEAR, PAUSE no RESUME

column1: IPv4 addresses or a.b.c.d/bits, comma separated; empty = only this computer
column2: Seòlaidhean IPv4 no a.b.c.d/bits, air an sgaradh le cromagan; bàn = an coimpiutair seo a-mhàin

column2: key+fill ON, ach gun uidheam key suidhichte (DECKLINK KEYFILL ON <device>)

column2: leubail | àithne | samhla      (bheir leubail|àithne bàn air falbh e)

column1: Lift or cut, 12dB either way. The centre is flat, so a band that has just been added does nothing until this is moved.
column2: Àrdaich no geàrr, 12dB gach taobh. Meadhan rèidh: cha dèan bann ùr càil gus an gluaisear seo

column1: Lifts the dark tones without moving pure black.
column2: Àrdaichidh na tònaichean dorcha gun dubh fìor atharrachadh

column1: Light on the drips, as on something wet: a gloss where it faces the light, darker where it curls away.
column2: Solas air na boinneagan mar rud fliuch: deàrrsadh ris an t-solas, nas dorcha far an lùb iad bhuaithe

column2: mic beò air na glaodhairean bunaiteach — thoir an aire do dh’ais-bhiadhadh

column2: MIDIIN: NOTE <n> <vel>, NOTEOFF <n>, CC <c> <v>, PITCH <0-16383>, PRESSURE <v>, KEYPRESSURE <n> <v>, PROGRAM <n> no OSC <address> [<n>], an uair sin CH <1-16> mura h-eil e air seanail 1

column1: Moves the direction of travel off the centre of frame, so the picture rushes past rather than straight at you.
column2: Gluaisidh taobh an t-siubhail bho mheadhan an fhrèama, gus an ruith an dealbh seachad ort seach dìreach thugad

column2: Chan eil càil ri mhasgadh: tagh gairm no atharraich MASK ON

column2: Aon smachd dhan chothromachadh gu lèir: fon mheadhan nas dorcha, os a chionn nas soilleire

column2: Gabh ri smachd cluiche bhon t-seòladair seo a-mhàin (bàn = duine sam bith)

column2: Dh’fhosgail github.com sa bhrabhsair — cha chuirear càil gus an cuir thu an aithris an sin

column1: Original: the picture pulled onto the figure. Sand: the picture as grains that are thrown off the moving parts and pour into each new figure. Fluid: the picture under water on the plate, bent and lit by its standing waves.
column2: Tùsail: an dealbh air a tharraing air a’ chumadh. Gainmheach: gràinnean na deilbh gan tilgeil bho phàirtean gluasadach gu gach cumadh ùr. Lionn: an dealbh fon uisge air a’ phlàta, lùbte is soillsichte le tonnan seasmhach

column1: output effects bypassed: no effect and no limit on this device
column2: Buaidhean às-chuir air an seachnadh: gun bhuaidh is gun chrìoch air an uidheam seo

column2: Àirde às-chuir ann am px — gabhar ri àireamhachadh: 1080x2, 2160/2, 540+30

column2: Leud às-chuir ann am px — gabhar ri àireamhachadh: 1920x2, 3840/2, 960+64

column2: Paidhir ri buaidh deilbh le LFO air Audio

column2: PATCH: ìre ann an dB bho -48 gu +6, no OFF

column2: Feumaidh fònaichean AN LÌONRA: suidhich 'Cò chì e' an toiseach

column2: Tha fuaim prògraim an-còmhnaidh ann; cleachd WEBMONITOR OFF gus am monatair a stad

column1: Pulls the bright tones down without moving pure white, so a hot highlight rolls off instead of clipping.
column2: Lùghdaichidh na tònaichean soilleir gun gheal fìor atharrachadh, gus am bi solas làidir a’ seargadh seach ga ghearradh

column1: Registry URL (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8010) - blank for mDNS
column2: URL clàrlainn (m.e. http://192.168.1.50:8010) — bàn airson mDNS

column1: Rotates the reading, so straight lines wind into spirals rather than rings.
column2: Tionndaidhidh an leughadh, gus an lùb loidhnichean dìreach nan snìomhain seach fàinneachan

column1: Rows lose sync and repeat one character, the way a real text screen breaks up. At 0 the grid is clean.
column2: Caillidh sreathan sioncronachadh is ath-aithrisidh iad aon charactar, mar sgrìn teacsa bhriste. Aig 0 tha an cliath glan

column2: Dh’fhàillig sàbhaladh — a’ feuchainn a-rithist; fhathast fosgailte, cleachd SAVE AS ma bhios feum air

column2: Air a shàbhaladh mar mo bhun-roghainnean: tòisichidh NEW mar an taisbeanadh seo, gun ghairmean

column2: Diogan airson gairmean ùra deilbh/pàtrain/brabhsair/Lower Third (0 = cum)

column2: Tagh gairm Draw an toiseach (SOURCE > MADE BY DECKBOY > Draw)

column2: SLICE CORNER: TL, TR, BR no BL, an uair sin dx dy sa cheud den às-chur

column1: SLICE EDGE: L, R, T or B, then 0-50 (% of the slice)
column2: SLICE EDGE: L, R, T no B, an uair sin 0-50 (% den sliseag)

column1: SLICE GRID POINT: col row (from 1, on a grid that is on) then dx dy in percent
column2: SLICE GRID POINT: col row (bho 1, air cliath a tha air), an uair sin dx dy sa cheud

column2: SLICE GRID: <cols> <rows> (2-9), OFF, SMOOTH ON|OFF no POINT col row dx dy

column2: SLICE LFO: X, Y, ROTATION no OPACITY, an uair sin ON, OFF, SHAPE, RATE, DEPTH...

column2: SLICE ROTATE: IN (am bàrradh) no OUT (an dealbh suidhichte), an uair sin ceuman

column2: Nochd rudeigin socair ann an SOURCE > MADE BY DECKBOY

column2: Rudeigin faisg air an deic: dùrdan fòin, pàtran cnàimh-sgadain bho lùghdaiche solais, bannan slaodach rèidio

column1: Sorts the runs the other way, so they pour from light to dark.
column2: Seòrsaichidh na ruith an rathad eile, bho shoilleir gu dorcha

column2: Tomhasan fuaime: tòisichidh àirde cho-aonaichte is fìor bhinnean a-rithist

column2: SOURCE WINDOW: ainmich an uinneag, m.e. title:Firefox (no "desktop")

column2: splitnotes: chan eil pàirtean aig nòtaichean na gairm (sgar le loidhne ---)

column2: URL srutha (srt://, rtmp://, rtsp://, udp:// no http HLS .m3u8)

column1: The brightness that stays put. Everything above it reaches one way and everything below it the other.
column2: An soilleireachd a sheasas fhathast. Thèid na tha os a chionn aon taobh, is na tha fodha an taobh eile

column1: The character of the growth: low is waves, then labyrinth, coral, worms, and holes at the top.
column2: Nàdar an fhàis: tonnan aig a’ bhonn, an uair sin cuartan, corail, cnuimhean is tuill aig a’ bhàrr

column2: Cleachdaidh am briogadair ceumannan nòtaichean mus gluais e air adhart

column1: The colour it becomes. Shading and brightness stay as they were, so a red shirt turns blue and keeps its folds.
column2: An dath ùr. Mairidh dubhar is soilleireachd; tionndaidhidh lèine dhearg gorm gun a fillidhean a chall

column1: The distance that sits ON the screen. Either side of it comes forward or falls behind.
column2: An t-astar AIR an sgrìn. Air gach taobh dheth thig e air adhart no tuitidh e air ais

column1: the file is empty (0 bytes): it may not have finished copying or saving
column2: Tha am faidhle bàn (0 baidht): dh’fhaodadh lethbhreacadh no sàbhaladh a bhith gun chrìochnachadh

column2: An tricead mun tionndaidh e — dè tha 'ìosal' is 'àrd' dhan chlaonadh
